"""Private native API fixture: real etcd and kube-apiserver, no kubeconfig changes."""
import base64
import contextlib
import http.client
import json
import os
import pathlib
import secrets
import socket
import ssl
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time


def free_port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


class Cluster:
    def __init__(self, encryption=None):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-s05-operator-b002-api-')
        self.root = pathlib.Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.processes = []
        self.api_name = 'apiserver'
        self.encryption_path = self.root/'encryption.json'
        self.port, self.etcd_port, self.peer_port = free_port(), free_port(), free_port()
        self.url = 'https://127.0.0.1:' + str(self.port)
        self.run('openssl', 'ecparam', '-name', 'prime256v1', '-genkey', '-noout', '-out', str(self.root/'ca.key'))
        self.run('openssl', 'req', '-x509', '-new', '-key', str(self.root/'ca.key'), '-out', str(self.root/'ca.crt'), '-days', '1', '-subj', '/CN=opsforge-pilot-private-ca')
        self.identity('server', 'localhost', extensions='subjectAltName=IP:127.0.0.1\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\n')
        self.identity('admin', 'opsforge-pilot-admin', 'system:masters')
        self.identity('learner', 'opsforge-pilot-user')
        (self.root/'encryption.json').write_text(json.dumps(encryption or {'apiVersion':'apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1','kind':'EncryptionConfiguration','resources':[{'resources':['secrets'],'providers':[{'identity':{}}]}]}))
        self.etcd = self.spawn('etcd', ['etcd', '--name=pilot', '--data-dir='+str(self.root/'data'), '--listen-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--advertise-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--listen-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-advertise-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-cluster=pilot=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--quota-backend-bytes=67108864', '--logger=zap', '--log-level=error'])
        self.wait_etcd()
        self.start_api()

    def run(self, *args):
        return subprocess.run(args, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)

    def identity(self, name, cn, org=None, extensions='extendedKeyUsage=clientAuth\n'):
        key, csr, crt = [self.root/(name+suffix) for suffix in ('.key','.csr','.crt')]
        self.run('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',str(key))
        self.run('openssl','req','-new','-key',str(key),'-out',str(csr),'-subj','/CN='+cn+('/O='+org if org else ''))
        ext=self.root/(name+'.ext');ext.write_text(extensions)
        self.run('openssl','x509','-req','-in',str(csr),'-CA',str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'-CAkey',str(self.root/'ca.key'),'-CAcreateserial','-out',str(crt),'-days','1','-extfile',str(ext))
        return name

    def spawn(self, name, args):
        handle=(self.root/(name+'.log')).open('ab')
        proc=subprocess.Popen(args,env={**os.environ,"GOMAXPROCS":"2","GOMEMLIMIT":"256MiB"},stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=handle,stderr=handle)
        handle.close();self.processes.append(proc)
        return proc

    def wait_etcd(self):
        for _ in range(120):
            try:
                conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=.3)
                conn.request('GET','/health');response=conn.getresponse();response.read();conn.close()
                if response.status==200:return
            except OSError:pass
            if self.etcd.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/'etcd.log').read_text())
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real etcd startup timed out')

    def start_api(self):
        self.api=self.spawn(self.api_name,['kube-apiserver','--bind-address=127.0.0.1','--advertise-address=127.0.0.1','--secure-port='+str(self.port),'--etcd-servers=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port),'--tls-cert-file='+str(self.root/'server.crt'),'--tls-private-key-file='+str(self.root/'server.key'),'--client-ca-file='+str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC','--enable-admission-plugins=NodeRestriction','--disable-admission-plugins=ServiceAccount','--anonymous-auth=false','--service-cluster-ip-range=10.240.0.0/24','--service-account-issuer=https://kubernetes.default.svc','--service-account-signing-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--service-account-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--encryption-provider-config='+str(self.encryption_path),'--profiling=false','--v=0'])
        for _ in range(240):
            try:
                code,_=self.request('GET','/readyz')
                if code==200:return
            except (OSError,ssl.SSLError,http.client.HTTPException):pass
            if self.api.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/(self.api_name+'.log')).read_text()[-10000:])
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real kube-apiserver startup timed out')

    def restart_api(self, encryption):
        self.api.terminate();self.api.wait(timeout=10)
        self.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        self.start_api()

    def peer(self, encryption):
        peer=object.__new__(Cluster)
        peer.root=self.root
        peer.processes=[]
        peer.port=free_port();peer.etcd_port=self.etcd_port
        peer.url='https://127.0.0.1:'+str(peer.port)
        peer.api_name='apiserver-peer-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
        peer.encryption_path=self.root/(peer.api_name+'.json')
        peer.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        peer.start_api()
        return peer

    def config(self, identity='learner'):
        result={'server':self.url,'ca':str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'cert':str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),'key':str(self.root/(identity+'.key'))}
        target=self.root/(identity+'-client.json');target.write_text(json.dumps(result))
        return str(target)

    def request(self, method, path, data=None, identity='admin', content_type='application/json'):
        context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(self.root/'ca.crt'))
        context.load_cert_chain(str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),str(self.root/(identity+'.key')))
        conn=http.client.HTTPSConnection('127.0.0.1',self.port,context=context,timeout=5)
        body=json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None
        conn.request(method,path,body=body,headers={'Content-Type':content_type})
        response=conn.getresponse();raw=response.read();code=response.status;conn.close()
        try:return code,json.loads(raw)
        except ValueError:return code,raw.decode(errors='replace')

    def create(self, path, obj):
        code,value=self.request('POST',path,obj)
        assert code==201,(code,value)
        return value

    def namespace(self, name):
        return self.create('/api/v1/namespaces',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Namespace','metadata':{'name':name}})

    def etcd_value(self, key):
        conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=5)
        conn.request('POST','/v3/kv/range',json.dumps({'key':base64.b64encode(key.encode()).decode()}),{'Content-Type':'application/json'})
        response=conn.getresponse();result=json.loads(response.read());conn.close()
        assert response.status==200,result
        return base64.b64decode(result['kvs'][0]['value'])

    def close(self):
        for proc in reversed(self.processes):
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.terminate()
                try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait()
        if hasattr(self,'tmp'):self.tmp.cleanup()

    def __enter__(self):return self
    def __exit__(self,*args):self.close()


if __name__=='__main__':
    started=time.monotonic()
    with Cluster() as cluster:
        print(json.dumps({'ready':cluster.request('GET','/readyz'),'version':cluster.request('GET','/version'),'seconds':time.monotonic()-started}),flush=True)

title: Manager中新增周期后台任务时，怎样交付NeedLeaderElection与多副本执行语义？
body:
## 环境与初始材料
固定Go模块、可信检查器及独立原生临时资源；仅编辑task.go和design.json。

## 操作任务
实现Background的Runnable/LeaderElectionRunnable合同。Role只取write/stats：write NeedLeaderElection=true，stats=false；Start按Interval周期调用Tick(ctx)，必须阻塞运行并在ctx取消后停止ticker返回nil。真实controller-runtime双Manager共享真实Lease选主，统计在两副本运行，健康端点不被leader阻塞；取消leader后旧写停止、新leader接替。不把选主当外部事务账本，跨崩溃任务仍需持久进度和幂等。

## 产物
task.go
design.json：按以下明确语义交付设计映射（JSON键值合同）
{"write_need_leader": true, "stats_need_leader": false, "start": "block-until-context-canceled", "health": "both-replicas", "handoff": "stop-old-writer-before-new-writer", "leader_election_is_durable_ledger": false}

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py，原生依赖须按本批模块准备清单预先安装；检查器离线，不临时联网。

## 能力边界
真实Go1.27.3、client-go v0.34.1和controller-runtime v0.22.3；自有独立CA/API Server1.34.1/etcd3.6.4，无fake client或伪造API。不安装Operator或业务镜像，不证明Pod运行、生产SLO或任意外部平台；默认身份、PATH、GOPATH、context不变。
source: OpsForge 高阶补充编审 2026-10-22
review_note: 作者语义编审；独立代理/跨会话独审尚未执行，不能算统一验收完成量。
rubric: 给出框架层和外部协议层各自责任
定义状态不变量与故障注入反例
证明陈旧或不完整证据不能触发危险动作

"""Private native API fixture: real etcd and kube-apiserver, no kubeconfig changes."""
import base64
import contextlib
import http.client
import json
import os
import pathlib
import secrets
import socket
import ssl
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time


def free_port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


class Cluster:
    def __init__(self, encryption=None):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-s05-operator-b002-api-')
        self.root = pathlib.Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.processes = []
        self.api_name = 'apiserver'
        self.encryption_path = self.root/'encryption.json'
        self.port, self.etcd_port, self.peer_port = free_port(), free_port(), free_port()
        self.url = 'https://127.0.0.1:' + str(self.port)
        self.run('openssl', 'ecparam', '-name', 'prime256v1', '-genkey', '-noout', '-out', str(self.root/'ca.key'))
        self.run('openssl', 'req', '-x509', '-new', '-key', str(self.root/'ca.key'), '-out', str(self.root/'ca.crt'), '-days', '1', '-subj', '/CN=opsforge-pilot-private-ca')
        self.identity('server', 'localhost', extensions='subjectAltName=IP:127.0.0.1\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\n')
        self.identity('admin', 'opsforge-pilot-admin', 'system:masters')
        self.identity('learner', 'opsforge-pilot-user')
        (self.root/'encryption.json').write_text(json.dumps(encryption or {'apiVersion':'apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1','kind':'EncryptionConfiguration','resources':[{'resources':['secrets'],'providers':[{'identity':{}}]}]}))
        self.etcd = self.spawn('etcd', ['etcd', '--name=pilot', '--data-dir='+str(self.root/'data'), '--listen-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--advertise-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--listen-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-advertise-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-cluster=pilot=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--quota-backend-bytes=67108864', '--logger=zap', '--log-level=error'])
        self.wait_etcd()
        self.start_api()

    def run(self, *args):
        return subprocess.run(args, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)

    def identity(self, name, cn, org=None, extensions='extendedKeyUsage=clientAuth\n'):
        key, csr, crt = [self.root/(name+suffix) for suffix in ('.key','.csr','.crt')]
        self.run('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',str(key))
        self.run('openssl','req','-new','-key',str(key),'-out',str(csr),'-subj','/CN='+cn+('/O='+org if org else ''))
        ext=self.root/(name+'.ext');ext.write_text(extensions)
        self.run('openssl','x509','-req','-in',str(csr),'-CA',str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'-CAkey',str(self.root/'ca.key'),'-CAcreateserial','-out',str(crt),'-days','1','-extfile',str(ext))
        return name

    def spawn(self, name, args):
        handle=(self.root/(name+'.log')).open('ab')
        proc=subprocess.Popen(args,env={**os.environ,"GOMAXPROCS":"2","GOMEMLIMIT":"256MiB"},stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=handle,stderr=handle)
        handle.close();self.processes.append(proc)
        return proc

    def wait_etcd(self):
        for _ in range(120):
            try:
                conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=.3)
                conn.request('GET','/health');response=conn.getresponse();response.read();conn.close()
                if response.status==200:return
            except OSError:pass
            if self.etcd.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/'etcd.log').read_text())
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real etcd startup timed out')

    def start_api(self):
        self.api=self.spawn(self.api_name,['kube-apiserver','--bind-address=127.0.0.1','--advertise-address=127.0.0.1','--secure-port='+str(self.port),'--etcd-servers=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port),'--tls-cert-file='+str(self.root/'server.crt'),'--tls-private-key-file='+str(self.root/'server.key'),'--client-ca-file='+str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC','--enable-admission-plugins=NodeRestriction','--disable-admission-plugins=ServiceAccount','--anonymous-auth=false','--service-cluster-ip-range=10.240.0.0/24','--service-account-issuer=https://kubernetes.default.svc','--service-account-signing-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--service-account-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--encryption-provider-config='+str(self.encryption_path),'--profiling=false','--v=0'])
        for _ in range(240):
            try:
                code,_=self.request('GET','/readyz')
                if code==200:return
            except (OSError,ssl.SSLError,http.client.HTTPException):pass
            if self.api.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/(self.api_name+'.log')).read_text()[-10000:])
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real kube-apiserver startup timed out')

    def restart_api(self, encryption):
        self.api.terminate();self.api.wait(timeout=10)
        self.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        self.start_api()

    def peer(self, encryption):
        peer=object.__new__(Cluster)
        peer.root=self.root
        peer.processes=[]
        peer.port=free_port();peer.etcd_port=self.etcd_port
        peer.url='https://127.0.0.1:'+str(peer.port)
        peer.api_name='apiserver-peer-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
        peer.encryption_path=self.root/(peer.api_name+'.json')
        peer.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        peer.start_api()
        return peer

    def config(self, identity='learner'):
        result={'server':self.url,'ca':str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'cert':str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),'key':str(self.root/(identity+'.key'))}
        target=self.root/(identity+'-client.json');target.write_text(json.dumps(result))
        return str(target)

    def request(self, method, path, data=None, identity='admin', content_type='application/json'):
        context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(self.root/'ca.crt'))
        context.load_cert_chain(str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),str(self.root/(identity+'.key')))
        conn=http.client.HTTPSConnection('127.0.0.1',self.port,context=context,timeout=5)
        body=json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None
        conn.request(method,path,body=body,headers={'Content-Type':content_type})
        response=conn.getresponse();raw=response.read();code=response.status;conn.close()
        try:return code,json.loads(raw)
        except ValueError:return code,raw.decode(errors='replace')

    def create(self, path, obj):
        code,value=self.request('POST',path,obj)
        assert code==201,(code,value)
        return value

    def namespace(self, name):
        return self.create('/api/v1/namespaces',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Namespace','metadata':{'name':name}})

    def etcd_value(self, key):
        conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=5)
        conn.request('POST','/v3/kv/range',json.dumps({'key':base64.b64encode(key.encode()).decode()}),{'Content-Type':'application/json'})
        response=conn.getresponse();result=json.loads(response.read());conn.close()
        assert response.status==200,result
        return base64.b64decode(result['kvs'][0]['value'])

    def close(self):
        for proc in reversed(self.processes):
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.terminate()
                try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait()
        if hasattr(self,'tmp'):self.tmp.cleanup()

    def __enter__(self):return self
    def __exit__(self,*args):self.close()


if __name__=='__main__':
    started=time.monotonic()
    with Cluster() as cluster:
        print(json.dumps({'ready':cluster.request('GET','/readyz'),'version':cluster.request('GET','/version'),'seconds':time.monotonic()-started}),flush=True)

实现migrate(request,collection,storage_version)。collection是目标v2跨命名空间Widget集合；storage_version(ns,name)由可信只读etcd探针返回真实持久apiVersion。limit=1分页读取，逐对象保持UID/spec/标签进行v2 PUT，迁移前后均须实际调用探针确认，不能猜测after=target；允许额外读取。已为v2不写，该次真实before观测可同时作为after，无须重复相同读取。返回namespace/name→{uid,before,after}完整凭据。任一步失败抛错，不退役旧版本或改storedVersions；全对象确证后由独立批准流程退役。样例两版本schema同构、conversion=None，不能外推需要Webhook的迁移；不同schema/转换路径须另验。

task.py

python3 checks/check.py；原生参考、未完成、错误、投机、不同错解、合法替代和资源清理。

真实Kubernetes1.34.1 API/etcd及题定原生组件；独立TLS与进程/临时目录。无镜像构建或现有集群部署；不外推Pod运行、云端事务或业务恢复。

def reconcile(request,path,now):
 import copy,hashlib,json
 code,obj=request('GET',path)
 if code!=200:raise RuntimeError('read failed')
 digest=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(obj['spec'],sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()
 status=copy.deepcopy(obj.get('status',{}));generation=obj['metadata']['generation']
 if status.get('observedDigest')==digest and status.get('observedGeneration')==generation:return False
 status.update(observedDigest=digest,observedGeneration=generation,lastChanged=now)
 code,_=request('PATCH',path+'/status',{'metadata':{'resourceVersion':obj['metadata']['resourceVersion']},'status':status},content_type='application/merge-patch+json')
 if code!=200:raise RuntimeError('status update failed')
 return True


原题解释：无实质变化仍写status，watch可能再次入队形成自触发循环，放大API与日志负载。只在可观察状态变化时更新，周期观察放独立计时或节流，验证静态CR在稳定后写入率接近预期。

    def namespace(self, name):

    def __exit__(self,*args):self.close()

    def peer(self, encryption):
        peer=object.__new__(Cluster)
        peer.root=self.root

        peer.port=free_port();peer.etcd_port=self.etcd_port

        for _ in range(240):

    def restart_api(self, encryption):

    def close(self):

## 环境与材料
平台提供Python、真实私有Kubernetes API/etcd与request(method,path,body=None,content_type=...)返回(status,object)；仅修改task.py。

## 操作任务
实现inventory(request,collection)、cleanup(request,path,approved_uid)、can_stop(request,collection)。这是明确仅管理ConfigMap的示例Operator卸载前安全门禁：无外部云资源、无转换Webhook，必须全namespace分页列出CR的UID/finalizers/deleting；只有获批UID且已deleting，检查全部带parent-uid标签CM的真实controller owner UID后，按子UID删除并GET404确认，再只移除自家s05.example/cleanup finalizer，保留其他finalizer。失败保留父finalizer，重复/重启可重新从API事实恢复；同名新UID不能拿旧批准清理。can_stop只有CR和带s05.example/operator=example的残留CM均空才True。记录原题部署/Webhook/外部责任清单后方可停止真正控制器，CRD最后；本题可信检查实际退役空CRD，但未安装/卸载生产Operator、未运行GC、不以删除finalizer冒充外部清理或GC。

## 产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；原生参考、未完成、错误、投机、不同错解、合法替代和资源清理。

## 能力边界
真实Kubernetes1.34.1 API/etcd及题定原生组件；独立TLS与进程/临时目录。无镜像构建或现有集群部署；不外推Pod运行、云端事务或业务恢复。

"""Private native API fixture: real etcd and kube-apiserver, no kubeconfig changes."""
import base64
import contextlib
import http.client
import json
import os
import pathlib
import secrets
import socket
import ssl
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
import threading


def free_port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


class Cluster:
    def __init__(self, encryption=None):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-s05-operator003-api-')
        self.root = pathlib.Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.processes = []
        self.started=time.monotonic()
        self.peak_owned_rss=0
        self.budget_alarm=None
        self.monitor_stop=threading.Event()
        self.monitor_thread=threading.Thread(target=self.monitor_owned,daemon=True)
        self.monitor_thread.start()
        self.api_name = 'apiserver'
        self.encryption_path = self.root/'encryption.json'
        self.port, self.etcd_port, self.peer_port = free_port(), free_port(), free_port()
        self.url = 'https://127.0.0.1:' + str(self.port)
        self.run('openssl', 'ecparam', '-name', 'prime256v1', '-genkey', '-noout', '-out', str(self.root/'ca.key'))
        self.run('openssl', 'req', '-x509', '-new', '-key', str(self.root/'ca.key'), '-out', str(self.root/'ca.crt'), '-days', '1', '-subj', '/CN=opsforge-pilot-private-ca')
        self.identity('server', 'localhost', extensions='subjectAltName=IP:127.0.0.1\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\n')
        self.identity('admin', 'opsforge-pilot-admin', 'system:masters')
        self.identity('learner', 'opsforge-pilot-user')
        (self.root/'encryption.json').write_text(json.dumps(encryption or {'apiVersion':'apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1','kind':'EncryptionConfiguration','resources':[{'resources':['secrets'],'providers':[{'identity':{}}]}]}))
        self.etcd = self.spawn('etcd', ['etcd', '--name=pilot', '--data-dir='+str(self.root/'data'), '--listen-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--advertise-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--listen-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-advertise-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-cluster=pilot=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--quota-backend-bytes=67108864', '--logger=zap', '--log-level=error'])
        try:
            self.wait_etcd()
            self.start_api()
        except BaseException:
            self.close()
            raise

    def monitor_owned(self):
        while not self.monitor_stop.wait(.1):
            total=0
            for p in list(self.processes):
                if p.poll() is not None:continue
                try:
                    status=pathlib.Path('/proc/'+str(p.pid)+'/status').read_text()
                    total+=int(next(line.split()[1] for line in status.splitlines() if line.startswith('VmRSS:')))*1024
                except (OSError,StopIteration,ValueError):pass
            self.peak_owned_rss=max(self.peak_owned_rss,total)
            if total>768*1024**2 or time.monotonic()-self.started>90:
                self.budget_alarm='owned_RSS_above_768MiB' if total>768*1024**2 else '90_second_deadline'
                for p in list(self.processes):
                    if p.poll() is None:p.terminate()
                return

    def run(self, *args):
        return subprocess.run(args, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)

    def identity(self, name, cn, org=None, extensions='extendedKeyUsage=clientAuth\n'):
        key, csr, crt = [self.root/(name+suffix) for suffix in ('.key','.csr','.crt')]
        self.run('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',str(key))
        self.run('openssl','req','-new','-key',str(key),'-out',str(csr),'-subj','/CN='+cn+('/O='+org if org else ''))
        ext=self.root/(name+'.ext');ext.write_text(extensions)
        self.run('openssl','x509','-req','-in',str(csr),'-CA',str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'-CAkey',str(self.root/'ca.key'),'-CAcreateserial','-out',str(crt),'-days','1','-extfile',str(ext))
        return name

    def spawn(self, name, args):
        handle=(self.root/(name+'.log')).open('ab')
        proc=subprocess.Popen(args,env={**os.environ,"GOMAXPROCS":"2","GOMEMLIMIT":"384MiB"},stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=handle,stderr=handle)
        handle.close();self.processes.append(proc)
        return proc

    def wait_etcd(self):
        for _ in range(120):
            try:
                conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=.3)
                conn.request('GET','/health');response=conn.getresponse();response.read();conn.close()
                if response.status==200:return
            except OSError:pass
            if self.etcd.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/'etcd.log').read_text())
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real etcd startup timed out')

    def start_api(self):
        self.api=self.spawn(self.api_name,['kube-apiserver','--bind-address=127.0.0.1','--advertise-address=127.0.0.1','--secure-port='+str(self.port),'--etcd-servers=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port),'--tls-cert-file='+str(self.root/'server.crt'),'--tls-private-key-file='+str(self.root/'server.key'),'--client-ca-file='+str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC','--enable-admission-plugins=NodeRestriction','--disable-admission-plugins=ServiceAccount','--anonymous-auth=false','--service-cluster-ip-range=10.240.0.0/24','--service-account-issuer=https://kubernetes.default.svc','--service-account-signing-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--service-account-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--encryption-provider-config='+str(self.encryption_path),'--profiling=false','--v=0'])
        for _ in range(240):
            try:
                code,_=self.request('GET','/readyz')
                if code==200:return
            except (OSError,ssl.SSLError,http.client.HTTPException):pass
            if self.api.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/(self.api_name+'.log')).read_text()[-10000:])
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real kube-apiserver startup timed out')

    def restart_api(self, encryption):
        self.api.terminate();self.api.wait(timeout=10)
        self.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        self.start_api()

    def peer(self, encryption):
        peer=object.__new__(Cluster)
        peer.root=self.root
        peer.processes=[]
        peer.port=free_port();peer.etcd_port=self.etcd_port
        peer.url='https://127.0.0.1:'+str(peer.port)
        peer.api_name='apiserver-peer-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
        peer.encryption_path=self.root/(peer.api_name+'.json')
        peer.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        peer.start_api()
        return peer

    def config(self, identity='learner'):
        result={'server':self.url,'ca':str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'cert':str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),'key':str(self.root/(identity+'.key'))}
        target=self.root/(identity+'-client.json');target.write_text(json.dumps(result))
        return str(target)

    def request(self, method, path, data=None, identity='admin', content_type='application/json'):
        context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(self.root/'ca.crt'))
        context.load_cert_chain(str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),str(self.root/(identity+'.key')))
        conn=http.client.HTTPSConnection('127.0.0.1',self.port,context=context,timeout=5)
        body=json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None
        conn.request(method,path,body=body,headers={'Content-Type':content_type})
        response=conn.getresponse();raw=response.read();code=response.status;conn.close()
        try:return code,json.loads(raw)
        except ValueError:return code,raw.decode(errors='replace')

    def create(self, path, obj):
        code,value=self.request('POST',path,obj)
        assert code==201,(code,value)
        return value

    def namespace(self, name):
        return self.create('/api/v1/namespaces',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Namespace','metadata':{'name':name}})

    def etcd_value(self, key):
        conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=5)
        conn.request('POST','/v3/kv/range',json.dumps({'key':base64.b64encode(key.encode()).decode()}),{'Content-Type':'application/json'})
        response=conn.getresponse();result=json.loads(response.read());conn.close()
        assert response.status==200,result
        return base64.b64decode(result['kvs'][0]['value'])

    def close(self):
        self.monitor_stop.set()
        self.monitor_thread.join(timeout=2)
        for proc in reversed(self.processes):
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.terminate()
                try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait()
        remaining=[p.pid for p in self.processes if p.poll() is None]
        print(json.dumps({'owned_processes':[p.pid for p in self.processes],'remaining_children':remaining,'owned_tempdir':str(self.root),'peak_owned_rss_bytes':self.peak_owned_rss,'budget_alarm':self.budget_alarm}),flush=True)
        assert not remaining
        if hasattr(self,'tmp'):self.tmp.cleanup()
        assert self.budget_alarm is None,self.budget_alarm

    def __enter__(self):return self
    def __exit__(self,*args):self.close()


if __name__=='__main__':

    with Cluster() as cluster:
        print(json.dumps({'ready':cluster.request('GET','/readyz'),'version':cluster.request('GET','/version'),'seconds':time.monotonic()-started}),flush=True)

## 环境与初始材料
固定Go module/sum、公开类型和可信原生检查。仅编辑task.go。

## 操作任务
实现NewMetrics与Observe：使用真实Prometheus CounterVec，唯一family=s05_reconcile_total，标签仅controller/result，controller只webapp/database/other，result只success/transient/permanent/other，未知值映射other。UID可供调用关联但绝不能作为标签值或永久保留。真实API创建/删除80个短命CR并观察，再补充10000个逻辑UID事件；最终仅3个实际series、counter总10081，真实HTTP抓取不得含UID、对象名或秘密。补充逻辑UID负载不是1万个已部署CR/Operator运行证据。

## 产物
task.go

python3 checks/check.py；真实Go test2json可信Test完成事件，禁止以零退出或未执行测试冒充通过。

真实Go1.27.3、client-go v0.34.1、controller-runtime v0.22.3、Prometheus Go client v1.22.0；固定私有API1.34.1/etcd3.6.4，自有PID及子进程总RSS768MiB/90秒预算，先编译后启动API，不改默认PATH/GOPATH/身份/context。原生Prometheus注册/收集/HTTP抓取；短命CR在真实私有API创建删除，无Operator镜像或业务Pod。不安装Operator或业务镜像，不证明生产运行、任意第三方云/数据库或生产SLO。

FIXED={'go.mod': 'e90c56df94139a1757a442f3d2a221ec0ce295bfa2d043a0bab49f46b782d4b2', 'go.sum': 'fedfeab0acb96fb9a900f64ed2bf7105dde96b747f378186ce75c75365caa0a7', 'model.go': 'b65248e5c3690ce62615271dccc87d1b8ecc62988f67d8efae2a7f574fc19492', 'contract.go': '61e99d6e856d693962110ba51496f091b8343e75720116598e811bfbfbfdd623'}
NEED_API=True
import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,re,signal,subprocess,sys,time
sys.path.insert(0,'checks')
from bounded_api import BoundedCluster
ROOT=pathlib.Path.cwd()
for name,digest in FIXED.items():
 assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,'fixed material modified: '+name
native=pathlib.Path('/tmp/opsforge-s05-operator-batch004-20261029')
if not (native/'gomodcache/k8s.io/client-go@v0.34.1').is_dir():raise RuntimeError('fixed native client-go module cache missing')
env=dict(os.environ,GOMODCACHE=str(native/'gomodcache'),GOCACHE=str(native/'gocache'),GOPROXY='off',GOTOOLCHAIN='local',GOMAXPROCS='2',GOMEMLIMIT='128MiB',CGO_ENABLED='0')
(ROOT/'native-tmp').mkdir(exist_ok=True);env['TMPDIR']=str(ROOT/'native-tmp')
from bounded_api import Budget
# Compile against the fixed real modules before starting native servers. This
# keeps compiler RSS and API RSS from unnecessarily overlapping; neither budget
# is relaxed. No application source is generated or changed during validation.
with Budget() as compile_budget:
 with (ROOT/'go-compile.log').open('wb') as log:
  compile_proc=subprocess.Popen(['go','test','-mod=readonly','-c','-o',str(ROOT/'native-tests'),'.'],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env=env,start_new_session=True)
  compile_budget.watch(compile_proc,group=True)
  while compile_proc.poll() is None:compile_budget.check();time.sleep(.03)
  compile_budget.check()
 if compile_proc.returncode:raise RuntimeError('native compilation failed: '+(ROOT/'go-compile.log').read_text()[-3000:])
def execute(budget):
 with (ROOT/'go-native.log').open('wb') as log:
  proc=subprocess.Popen(['go','tool','test2json','-t','-p','opsforge.local/operatorbatch004',str(ROOT/'native-tests'),'-test.count=1','-test.timeout=65s','-test.v=test2json'],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env=env,start_new_session=True)
  budget.watch(proc,group=True)
  while proc.poll() is None:
   budget.check();time.sleep(.03)
  budget.check()
 text=(ROOT/'go-native.log').read_text();print(text)
 if proc.returncode and '--- FAIL:' not in text and 'panic: IMPLEMENT_NATIVE_OPERATION' not in text:raise RuntimeError('native build/tool/checker error: '+text[-3000:])
 assert proc.returncode==0,'native semantic tests failed'
 expected=set(re.findall(r'^func (Test\w+)\(', (ROOT/'native_test.go').read_text(),re.M))
 events=[json.loads(line) for line in text.splitlines() if line.startswith('{')]
 passed={e.get('Test') for e in events if e.get('Action')=='pass' and e.get('Test')}
 assert expected and expected<=passed,'native tests did not all complete; early exit is not success'
if NEED_API:
 with BoundedCluster() as cluster:
  env['OPSF_PRIVATE_CONFIG']=cluster.config('admin');execute(cluster.budget)
else:
 with Budget() as budget:execute(budget)
print('NATIVE_OPERATOR_B004_COMPLETE')

"""Private native API fixture: real etcd and kube-apiserver, no kubeconfig changes."""
import base64
import contextlib
import http.client
import json
import os
import pathlib
import secrets
import socket
import ssl
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time


def free_port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


class Cluster:
    def __init__(self, encryption=None):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-s05-operator-b004-api-')
        self.root = pathlib.Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.processes = []
        self.api_name = 'apiserver'
        self.encryption_path = self.root/'encryption.json'
        self.port, self.etcd_port, self.peer_port = free_port(), free_port(), free_port()
        self.url = 'https://127.0.0.1:' + str(self.port)
        self.run('openssl', 'ecparam', '-name', 'prime256v1', '-genkey', '-noout', '-out', str(self.root/'ca.key'))
        self.run('openssl', 'req', '-x509', '-new', '-key', str(self.root/'ca.key'), '-out', str(self.root/'ca.crt'), '-days', '1', '-subj', '/CN=opsforge-pilot-private-ca')
        self.identity('server', 'localhost', extensions='subjectAltName=IP:127.0.0.1\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\n')
        self.identity('admin', 'opsforge-pilot-admin', 'system:masters')
        self.identity('learner', 'opsforge-pilot-user')
        (self.root/'encryption.json').write_text(json.dumps(encryption or {'apiVersion':'apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1','kind':'EncryptionConfiguration','resources':[{'resources':['secrets'],'providers':[{'identity':{}}]}]}))
        self.etcd = self.spawn('etcd', ['etcd', '--name=pilot', '--data-dir='+str(self.root/'data'), '--listen-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--advertise-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--listen-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-advertise-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-cluster=pilot=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--quota-backend-bytes=67108864', '--logger=zap', '--log-level=error'])
        self.wait_etcd()
        self.start_api()

    def run(self, *args):
        return subprocess.run(args, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)

    def identity(self, name, cn, org=None, extensions='extendedKeyUsage=clientAuth\n'):
        key, csr, crt = [self.root/(name+suffix) for suffix in ('.key','.csr','.crt')]
        self.run('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',str(key))
        self.run('openssl','req','-new','-key',str(key),'-out',str(csr),'-subj','/CN='+cn+('/O='+org if org else ''))
        ext=self.root/(name+'.ext');ext.write_text(extensions)
        self.run('openssl','x509','-req','-in',str(csr),'-CA',str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'-CAkey',str(self.root/'ca.key'),'-CAcreateserial','-out',str(crt),'-days','1','-extfile',str(ext))
        return name

    def spawn(self, name, args):
        handle=(self.root/(name+'.log')).open('ab')
        proc=subprocess.Popen(args,env={**os.environ,"GOMAXPROCS":"2","GOMEMLIMIT":"256MiB"},stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=handle,stderr=handle)
        handle.close();self.processes.append(proc)
        return proc

    def wait_etcd(self):
        for _ in range(120):
            try:
                conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=.3)
                conn.request('GET','/health');response=conn.getresponse();response.read();conn.close()
                if response.status==200:return
            except OSError:pass
            if self.etcd.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/'etcd.log').read_text())
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real etcd startup timed out')

    def start_api(self):
        self.api=self.spawn(self.api_name,['kube-apiserver','--bind-address=127.0.0.1','--advertise-address=127.0.0.1','--secure-port='+str(self.port),'--etcd-servers=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port),'--tls-cert-file='+str(self.root/'server.crt'),'--tls-private-key-file='+str(self.root/'server.key'),'--client-ca-file='+str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC','--enable-admission-plugins=NodeRestriction','--disable-admission-plugins=ServiceAccount','--anonymous-auth=false','--service-cluster-ip-range=10.240.0.0/24','--service-account-issuer=https://kubernetes.default.svc','--service-account-signing-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--service-account-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--encryption-provider-config='+str(self.encryption_path),'--profiling=false','--v=0'])
        for _ in range(240):
            try:
                code,_=self.request('GET','/readyz')
                if code==200:return
            except (OSError,ssl.SSLError,http.client.HTTPException):pass
            if self.api.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/(self.api_name+'.log')).read_text()[-10000:])
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real kube-apiserver startup timed out')

    def restart_api(self, encryption):
        self.api.terminate();self.api.wait(timeout=10)
        self.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        self.start_api()

    def peer(self, encryption):
        peer=object.__new__(Cluster)
        peer.root=self.root
        peer.processes=[]
        peer.port=free_port();peer.etcd_port=self.etcd_port
        peer.url='https://127.0.0.1:'+str(peer.port)
        peer.api_name='apiserver-peer-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
        peer.encryption_path=self.root/(peer.api_name+'.json')
        peer.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        peer.start_api()
        return peer

    def config(self, identity='learner'):
        result={'server':self.url,'ca':str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'cert':str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),'key':str(self.root/(identity+'.key'))}
        target=self.root/(identity+'-client.json');target.write_text(json.dumps(result))
        return str(target)

    def request(self, method, path, data=None, identity='admin', content_type='application/json'):
        context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(self.root/'ca.crt'))
        context.load_cert_chain(str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),str(self.root/(identity+'.key')))
        conn=http.client.HTTPSConnection('127.0.0.1',self.port,context=context,timeout=5)
        body=json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None
        conn.request(method,path,body=body,headers={'Content-Type':content_type})
        response=conn.getresponse();raw=response.read();code=response.status;conn.close()
        try:return code,json.loads(raw)
        except ValueError:return code,raw.decode(errors='replace')

    def create(self, path, obj):
        code,value=self.request('POST',path,obj)
        assert code==201,(code,value)
        return value

    def namespace(self, name):
        return self.create('/api/v1/namespaces',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Namespace','metadata':{'name':name}})

    def etcd_value(self, key):
        conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=5)
        conn.request('POST','/v3/kv/range',json.dumps({'key':base64.b64encode(key.encode()).decode()}),{'Content-Type':'application/json'})
        response=conn.getresponse();result=json.loads(response.read());conn.close()
        assert response.status==200,result
        return base64.b64decode(result['kvs'][0]['value'])

    def close(self):
        for proc in reversed(self.processes):
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.terminate()
                try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait()
        if hasattr(self,'tmp'):self.tmp.cleanup()

    def __enter__(self):return self
    def __exit__(self,*args):self.close()


if __name__=='__main__':
    started=time.monotonic()
    with Cluster() as cluster:
        print(json.dumps({'ready':cluster.request('GET','/readyz'),'version':cluster.request('GET','/version'),'seconds':time.monotonic()-started}),flush=True)

## 环境与初始材料
固定Go module/sum、公开类型和可信原生检查。仅编辑task.go。

## 操作任务
实现Cleanup：仅允许ConfigMap、显式非空namespace、非空WorkApp owner UID及恰好training.s05/cleanup=approved这一标签选择器。真实服务端List后，逐个核对controller ownerReference的kind/API/UID，不能把同标签当所有权；用各对象UID和resourceVersion原子前置条件逐项Delete，返回实际删除UID，NotFound跳过、其他错误立即停止并返回已删除审计。禁止DeleteAllOf代替已审集合。真实SDK先演示空选择器DeleteAllOf会删除同namespace未授权私有夹具，再验证安全路径保护同标签非子对象、Secret、跨namespace同名对象，以及List后实际删除重建同名对象时旧UID删除409拒绝。失败不能以重建原UID冒充回滚。

## 产物
task.go

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；真实Go test2json可信Test完成事件，禁止以零退出或未执行测试冒充通过。

## 能力边界
真实Go1.27.3、client-go v0.34.1、controller-runtime v0.22.3、Prometheus Go client v1.22.0；固定私有API1.34.1/etcd3.6.4，自有PID及子进程总RSS768MiB/90秒预算，先编译后启动API，不改默认PATH/GOPATH/身份/context。真实controller-runtime DeleteAllOf/Delete/List及API UID冲突；危险示例只操作本题新建的私有命名空间，无fake client。不安装Operator或业务镜像，不证明生产运行、任意第三方云/数据库或生产SLO。
source: OpsForge 高阶补充编审 2026-10-22
review_note: 作者原生候选，作者外独审/会话10统一验收登记未完成，不计完成量。
rubric: 给出框架层和外部协议层各自责任
定义状态不变量与故障注入反例
证明陈旧或不完整证据不能触发危险动作

        key, csr, crt = [self.root/(name+suffix) for suffix in ('.key','.csr','.crt')]
        self.run('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',str(key))
        self.run('openssl','req','-new','-key',str(key),'-out',str(csr),'-subj','/CN='+cn+('/O='+org if org else ''))
        ext=self.root/(name+'.ext');ext.write_text(extensions)
        self.run('openssl','x509','-req','-in',str(csr),'-CA',str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'-CAkey',str(self.root/'ca.key'),'-CAcreateserial','-out',str(crt),'-days','1','-extfile',str(ext))
        return name

    def spawn(self, name, args):
        handle=(self.root/(name+'.log')).open('ab')
        proc=subprocess.Popen(args,env={**os.environ,"GOMAXPROCS":"2","GOMEMLIMIT":"256MiB"},stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=handle,stderr=handle)
        handle.close();self.processes.append(proc)
        return proc

    def wait_etcd(self):
        for _ in range(120):
            try:
                conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=.3)
                conn.request('GET','/health');response=conn.getresponse();response.read();conn.close()
                if response.status==200:return
            except OSError:pass
            if self.etcd.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/'etcd.log').read_text())
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real etcd startup timed out')

    def start_api(self):
        self.api=self.spawn(self.api_name,['kube-apiserver','--bind-address=127.0.0.1','--advertise-address=127.0.0.1','--secure-port='+str(self.port),'--etcd-servers=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port),'--tls-cert-file='+str(self.root/'server.crt'),'--tls-private-key-file='+str(self.root/'server.key'),'--client-ca-file='+str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC','--enable-admission-plugins=NodeRestriction','--disable-admission-plugins=ServiceAccount','--anonymous-auth=false','--service-cluster-ip-range=10.240.0.0/24','--service-account-issuer=https://kubernetes.default.svc','--service-account-signing-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--service-account-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--encryption-provider-config='+str(self.encryption_path),'--profiling=false','--v=0'])
        for _ in range(240):
            try:
                code,_=self.request('GET','/readyz')
                if code==200:return
            except (OSError,ssl.SSLError,http.client.HTTPException):pass
            if self.api.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/(self.api_name+'.log')).read_text()[-10000:])
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real kube-apiserver startup timed out')

    def restart_api(self, encryption):
        self.api.terminate();self.api.wait(timeout=10)
        self.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        self.start_api()

    def peer(self, encryption):
        peer=object.__new__(Cluster)
        peer.root=self.root
        peer.processes=[]
        peer.port=free_port();peer.etcd_port=self.etcd_port
        peer.url='https://127.0.0.1:'+str(peer.port)
        peer.api_name='apiserver-peer-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
        peer.encryption_path=self.root/(peer.api_name+'.json')
        peer.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        peer.start_api()
        return peer

    def config(self, identity='learner'):
        result={'server':self.url,'ca':str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'cert':str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),'key':str(self.root/(identity+'.key'))}
        target=self.root/(identity+'-client.json');target.write_text(json.dumps(result))
        return str(target)

    def request(self, method, path, data=None, identity='admin', content_type='application/json'):
        context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(self.root/'ca.crt'))
        context.load_cert_chain(str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),str(self.root/(identity+'.key')))
        conn=http.client.HTTPSConnection('127.0.0.1',self.port,context=context,timeout=5)
        body=json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None
        conn.request(method,path,body=body,headers={'Content-Type':content_type})
        response=conn.getresponse();raw=response.read();code=response.status;conn.close()
        try:return code,json.loads(raw)
        except ValueError:return code,raw.decode(errors='replace')

    def create(self, path, obj):
        code,value=self.request('POST',path,obj)
        assert code==201,(code,value)
        return value

    def namespace(self, name):
        return self.create('/api/v1/namespaces',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Namespace','metadata':{'name':name}})

    def etcd_value(self, key):
        conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=5)
        conn.request('POST','/v3/kv/range',json.dumps({'key':base64.b64encode(key.encode()).decode()}),{'Content-Type':'application/json'})
        response=conn.getresponse();result=json.loads(response.read());conn.close()
        assert response.status==200,result
        return base64.b64decode(result['kvs'][0]['value'])

    def close(self):
        for proc in reversed(self.processes):
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.terminate()
                try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait()
        if hasattr(self,'tmp'):self.tmp.cleanup()

    def __enter__(self):return self
    def __exit__(self,*args):self.close()


if __name__=='__main__':
    started=time.monotonic()
    with Cluster() as cluster:
        print(json.dumps({'ready':cluster.request('GET','/readyz'),'version':cluster.request('GET','/version'),'seconds':time.monotonic()-started}),flush=True)

## 环境与初始材料
固定Go module/sum、公开类型和可信原生检查。仅编辑task.go。

## 操作任务
实现Diagnose的只读诊断：读取指定WorkApp与批准ConfigMap里的version/logLevel(error/info/debug)/paused/retryAfter(0..1min)/maxEvents(1..10)，无效配置拒绝。返回真实UID/generation/observedGeneration、仅当前代数Ready、稳定白名单Reason、受限op-操作ID、版本/受支持诊断参数、同namespace且controller owner UID匹配的子ConfigMap元数据、最多maxEvents条该UID原生Event的type/reason及HasMoreEvents。未知Reason映射UnknownReason，旧Ready代数必须标ObservedGenerationStale。禁止读取Secret正文、输出完整Spec/Status/Condition/Event message或子对象data；秘密会被真实夹具放入这些不安全字段。诊断参数在此只做读取/校验/展示，不声称实际生产Operator已暂停或恢复；条件/事件为真实API声明，不是业务健康证明。

## 产物
task.go

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；真实Go test2json可信Test完成事件，禁止以零退出或未执行测试冒充通过。

## 能力边界
真实Go1.27.3、client-go v0.34.1、controller-runtime v0.22.3、Prometheus Go client v1.22.0；固定私有API1.34.1/etcd3.6.4，自有PID及子进程总RSS768MiB/90秒预算，先编译后启动API，不改默认PATH/GOPATH/身份/context。真实原生API只读诊断与实际ConfigMap参数，私有Secret/CR/child/Event均为独立原生对象；不输出秘密正文。不安装Operator或业务镜像，不证明生产运行、任意第三方云/数据库或生产SLO。

"""Private native API fixture: real etcd and kube-apiserver, no kubeconfig changes."""
import base64
import contextlib
import http.client
import json
import os
import pathlib
import secrets
import socket
import ssl
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time


def free_port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


class Cluster:
    def __init__(self, encryption=None):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-s05-operator-b004-api-')
        self.root = pathlib.Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.processes = []
        self.api_name = 'apiserver'
        self.encryption_path = self.root/'encryption.json'
        self.port, self.etcd_port, self.peer_port = free_port(), free_port(), free_port()
        self.url = 'https://127.0.0.1:' + str(self.port)
        self.run('openssl', 'ecparam', '-name', 'prime256v1', '-genkey', '-noout', '-out', str(self.root/'ca.key'))
        self.run('openssl', 'req', '-x509', '-new', '-key', str(self.root/'ca.key'), '-out', str(self.root/'ca.crt'), '-days', '1', '-subj', '/CN=opsforge-pilot-private-ca')
        self.identity('server', 'localhost', extensions='subjectAltName=IP:127.0.0.1\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\n')
        self.identity('admin', 'opsforge-pilot-admin', 'system:masters')
        self.identity('learner', 'opsforge-pilot-user')
        (self.root/'encryption.json').write_text(json.dumps(encryption or {'apiVersion':'apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1','kind':'EncryptionConfiguration','resources':[{'resources':['secrets'],'providers':[{'identity':{}}]}]}))
        self.etcd = self.spawn('etcd', ['etcd', '--name=pilot', '--data-dir='+str(self.root/'data'), '--listen-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--advertise-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--listen-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-advertise-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-cluster=pilot=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--quota-backend-bytes=67108864', '--logger=zap', '--log-level=error'])
        self.wait_etcd()
        self.start_api()

    def run(self, *args):
        return subprocess.run(args, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)

    def identity(self, name, cn, org=None, extensions='extendedKeyUsage=clientAuth\n'):
        key, csr, crt = [self.root/(name+suffix) for suffix in ('.key','.csr','.crt')]
        self.run('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',str(key))
        self.run('openssl','req','-new','-key',str(key),'-out',str(csr),'-subj','/CN='+cn+('/O='+org if org else ''))
        ext=self.root/(name+'.ext');ext.write_text(extensions)
        self.run('openssl','x509','-req','-in',str(csr),'-CA',str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'-CAkey',str(self.root/'ca.key'),'-CAcreateserial','-out',str(crt),'-days','1','-extfile',str(ext))
        return name

    def spawn(self, name, args):
        handle=(self.root/(name+'.log')).open('ab')
        proc=subprocess.Popen(args,env={**os.environ,"GOMAXPROCS":"2","GOMEMLIMIT":"256MiB"},stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=handle,stderr=handle)
        handle.close();self.processes.append(proc)
        return proc

    def wait_etcd(self):
        for _ in range(120):
            try:
                conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=.3)
                conn.request('GET','/health');response=conn.getresponse();response.read();conn.close()
                if response.status==200:return
            except OSError:pass
            if self.etcd.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/'etcd.log').read_text())
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real etcd startup timed out')

    def start_api(self):
        self.api=self.spawn(self.api_name,['kube-apiserver','--bind-address=127.0.0.1','--advertise-address=127.0.0.1','--secure-port='+str(self.port),'--etcd-servers=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port),'--tls-cert-file='+str(self.root/'server.crt'),'--tls-private-key-file='+str(self.root/'server.key'),'--client-ca-file='+str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC','--enable-admission-plugins=NodeRestriction','--disable-admission-plugins=ServiceAccount','--anonymous-auth=false','--service-cluster-ip-range=10.240.0.0/24','--service-account-issuer=https://kubernetes.default.svc','--service-account-signing-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--service-account-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--encryption-provider-config='+str(self.encryption_path),'--profiling=false','--v=0'])
        for _ in range(240):
            try:
                code,_=self.request('GET','/readyz')
                if code==200:return
            except (OSError,ssl.SSLError,http.client.HTTPException):pass
            if self.api.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/(self.api_name+'.log')).read_text()[-10000:])
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real kube-apiserver startup timed out')

    def restart_api(self, encryption):
        self.api.terminate();self.api.wait(timeout=10)
        self.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        self.start_api()

    def peer(self, encryption):
        peer=object.__new__(Cluster)
        peer.root=self.root
        peer.processes=[]
        peer.port=free_port();peer.etcd_port=self.etcd_port
        peer.url='https://127.0.0.1:'+str(peer.port)
        peer.api_name='apiserver-peer-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
        peer.encryption_path=self.root/(peer.api_name+'.json')
        peer.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        peer.start_api()
        return peer

    def config(self, identity='learner'):
        result={'server':self.url,'ca':str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'cert':str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),'key':str(self.root/(identity+'.key'))}
        target=self.root/(identity+'-client.json');target.write_text(json.dumps(result))
        return str(target)

    def request(self, method, path, data=None, identity='admin', content_type='application/json'):
        context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(self.root/'ca.crt'))
        context.load_cert_chain(str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),str(self.root/(identity+'.key')))
        conn=http.client.HTTPSConnection('127.0.0.1',self.port,context=context,timeout=5)
        body=json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None
        conn.request(method,path,body=body,headers={'Content-Type':content_type})
        response=conn.getresponse();raw=response.read();code=response.status;conn.close()
        try:return code,json.loads(raw)
        except ValueError:return code,raw.decode(errors='replace')

    def create(self, path, obj):
        code,value=self.request('POST',path,obj)
        assert code==201,(code,value)
        return value

    def namespace(self, name):
        return self.create('/api/v1/namespaces',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Namespace','metadata':{'name':name}})

    def etcd_value(self, key):
        conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=5)
        conn.request('POST','/v3/kv/range',json.dumps({'key':base64.b64encode(key.encode()).decode()}),{'Content-Type':'application/json'})
        response=conn.getresponse();result=json.loads(response.read());conn.close()
        assert response.status==200,result
        return base64.b64decode(result['kvs'][0]['value'])

    def close(self):
        for proc in reversed(self.processes):
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.terminate()
                try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait()
        if hasattr(self,'tmp'):self.tmp.cleanup()

    def __enter__(self):return self
    def __exit__(self,*args):self.close()


if __name__=='__main__':
    started=time.monotonic()
    with Cluster() as cluster:
        print(json.dumps({'ready':cluster.request('GET','/readyz'),'version':cluster.request('GET','/version'),'seconds':time.monotonic()-started}),flush=True)

## 环境与初始材料
固定Go module/sum、公开类型和可信原生检查。仅编辑task.go。

## 操作任务
实现AlphaToHub/HubToAlpha/BetaToHub/HubToBeta，三种真实CRD版本围绕Hub(v1)转换：alpha毫秒整数、hub纳秒整数、beta精确十进制秒。所有仍served版本共同只支持毫秒精度，禁止溢出/舍入/信息丢失；保留mode及ObjectMeta身份/标签。三版本默认超时分别1000ms/1e9ns/"1"s、mode=normal，语义等价。真实controller-runtime HTTPS转换Handler由实际API Server在跨版本创建/读取/更新时调用；验证alpha→hub→beta及beta→hub→alpha往返、默认语义、UID/标签保留与不可表示值拒绝。Hub不是任意可丢字段的中间格式；新精度或字段变更仍须覆盖所有served spoke。

## 产物
task.go

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；真实Go test2json可信Test完成事件，禁止以零退出或未执行测试冒充通过。

## 能力边界
真实Go1.27.3、client-go v0.34.1、controller-runtime v0.22.3、Prometheus Go client v1.22.0；固定私有API1.34.1/etcd3.6.4，自有PID及子进程总RSS768MiB/90秒预算，先编译后启动API，不改默认PATH/GOPATH/身份/context。实际API发起的TLS ConversionReview、真实controller-runtime hub/spoke接口；无手造HTTP后端替代转换实现。不安装Operator或业务镜像，不证明生产运行、任意第三方云/数据库或生产SLO。

"""Private native API fixture: real etcd and kube-apiserver, no kubeconfig changes."""
import base64
import contextlib
import http.client
import json
import os
import pathlib
import secrets
import socket
import ssl
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time


def free_port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


class Cluster:
    def __init__(self, encryption=None):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-s05-operator-b004-api-')
        self.root = pathlib.Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.processes = []
        self.api_name = 'apiserver'
        self.encryption_path = self.root/'encryption.json'
        self.port, self.etcd_port, self.peer_port = free_port(), free_port(), free_port()
        self.url = 'https://127.0.0.1:' + str(self.port)
        self.run('openssl', 'ecparam', '-name', 'prime256v1', '-genkey', '-noout', '-out', str(self.root/'ca.key'))
        self.run('openssl', 'req', '-x509', '-new', '-key', str(self.root/'ca.key'), '-out', str(self.root/'ca.crt'), '-days', '1', '-subj', '/CN=opsforge-pilot-private-ca')
        self.identity('server', 'localhost', extensions='subjectAltName=IP:127.0.0.1\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\n')
        self.identity('admin', 'opsforge-pilot-admin', 'system:masters')
        self.identity('learner', 'opsforge-pilot-user')
        (self.root/'encryption.json').write_text(json.dumps(encryption or {'apiVersion':'apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1','kind':'EncryptionConfiguration','resources':[{'resources':['secrets'],'providers':[{'identity':{}}]}]}))
        self.etcd = self.spawn('etcd', ['etcd', '--name=pilot', '--data-dir='+str(self.root/'data'), '--listen-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--advertise-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--listen-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-advertise-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-cluster=pilot=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--quota-backend-bytes=67108864', '--logger=zap', '--log-level=error'])
        self.wait_etcd()
        self.start_api()

    def run(self, *args):
        return subprocess.run(args, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)

    def identity(self, name, cn, org=None, extensions='extendedKeyUsage=clientAuth\n'):
        key, csr, crt = [self.root/(name+suffix) for suffix in ('.key','.csr','.crt')]
        self.run('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',str(key))
        self.run('openssl','req','-new','-key',str(key),'-out',str(csr),'-subj','/CN='+cn+('/O='+org if org else ''))
        ext=self.root/(name+'.ext');ext.write_text(extensions)
        self.run('openssl','x509','-req','-in',str(csr),'-CA',str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'-CAkey',str(self.root/'ca.key'),'-CAcreateserial','-out',str(crt),'-days','1','-extfile',str(ext))
        return name

    def spawn(self, name, args):
        handle=(self.root/(name+'.log')).open('ab')
        proc=subprocess.Popen(args,env={**os.environ,"GOMAXPROCS":"2","GOMEMLIMIT":"256MiB"},stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=handle,stderr=handle)
        handle.close();self.processes.append(proc)
        return proc

    def wait_etcd(self):
        for _ in range(120):
            try:
                conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=.3)
                conn.request('GET','/health');response=conn.getresponse();response.read();conn.close()
                if response.status==200:return
            except OSError:pass
            if self.etcd.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/'etcd.log').read_text())
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real etcd startup timed out')

    def start_api(self):
        self.api=self.spawn(self.api_name,['kube-apiserver','--bind-address=127.0.0.1','--advertise-address=127.0.0.1','--secure-port='+str(self.port),'--etcd-servers=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port),'--tls-cert-file='+str(self.root/'server.crt'),'--tls-private-key-file='+str(self.root/'server.key'),'--client-ca-file='+str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC','--enable-admission-plugins=NodeRestriction','--disable-admission-plugins=ServiceAccount','--anonymous-auth=false','--service-cluster-ip-range=10.240.0.0/24','--service-account-issuer=https://kubernetes.default.svc','--service-account-signing-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--service-account-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--encryption-provider-config='+str(self.encryption_path),'--profiling=false','--v=0'])
        for _ in range(240):
            try:
                code,_=self.request('GET','/readyz')
                if code==200:return
            except (OSError,ssl.SSLError,http.client.HTTPException):pass
            if self.api.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/(self.api_name+'.log')).read_text()[-10000:])
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real kube-apiserver startup timed out')

    def restart_api(self, encryption):
        self.api.terminate();self.api.wait(timeout=10)
        self.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        self.start_api()

    def peer(self, encryption):
        peer=object.__new__(Cluster)
        peer.root=self.root
        peer.processes=[]
        peer.port=free_port();peer.etcd_port=self.etcd_port
        peer.url='https://127.0.0.1:'+str(peer.port)
        peer.api_name='apiserver-peer-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
        peer.encryption_path=self.root/(peer.api_name+'.json')
        peer.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        peer.start_api()
        return peer

    def config(self, identity='learner'):
        result={'server':self.url,'ca':str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'cert':str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),'key':str(self.root/(identity+'.key'))}
        target=self.root/(identity+'-client.json');target.write_text(json.dumps(result))
        return str(target)

    def request(self, method, path, data=None, identity='admin', content_type='application/json'):
        context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(self.root/'ca.crt'))
        context.load_cert_chain(str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),str(self.root/(identity+'.key')))
        conn=http.client.HTTPSConnection('127.0.0.1',self.port,context=context,timeout=5)
        body=json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None
        conn.request(method,path,body=body,headers={'Content-Type':content_type})
        response=conn.getresponse();raw=response.read();code=response.status;conn.close()
        try:return code,json.loads(raw)
        except ValueError:return code,raw.decode(errors='replace')

    def create(self, path, obj):
        code,value=self.request('POST',path,obj)
        assert code==201,(code,value)
        return value

    def namespace(self, name):
        return self.create('/api/v1/namespaces',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Namespace','metadata':{'name':name}})

    def etcd_value(self, key):
        conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=5)
        conn.request('POST','/v3/kv/range',json.dumps({'key':base64.b64encode(key.encode()).decode()}),{'Content-Type':'application/json'})
        response=conn.getresponse();result=json.loads(response.read());conn.close()
        assert response.status==200,result
        return base64.b64decode(result['kvs'][0]['value'])

    def close(self):
        for proc in reversed(self.processes):
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.terminate()
                try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait()
        if hasattr(self,'tmp'):self.tmp.cleanup()

    def __enter__(self):return self
    def __exit__(self,*args):self.close()


if __name__=='__main__':
    started=time.monotonic()
    with Cluster() as cluster:
        print(json.dumps({'ready':cluster.request('GET','/readyz'),'version':cluster.request('GET','/version'),'seconds':time.monotonic()-started}),flush=True)

## 环境与初始材料
固定Go module/sum、公开类型和可信原生检查。仅编辑task.go。

## 操作任务
实现UpgradeConversion：先执行提供的真实HTTPS/ConversionReview兼容与证书probe，失败不得改变旧路径。通过后使用真实CRD客户端把兼容新URL/CABundle和storage=v1切入，仍保留legacy served；从实际API列出全部Hub Widget并逐项PUT，真正重写etcd存储，再更新storedVersions仅v1，最后退役v1alpha1 served。不得先关旧Webhook、只改status假称迁移或吞掉错误。夹具从真实v1alpha1存储开始，验证坏CA、HTTPS成功但缺beta的原生handler拒绝且旧API可读；成功后直接读取自有etcd原始对象确认两条记录均v1，再关闭旧server，Hub/beta仍可读且UID/数据不丢。此固定受支持版本图不代表任意CRD转换升级。

## 产物
task.go

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；真实Go test2json可信Test完成事件，禁止以零退出或未执行测试冒充通过。

## 能力边界
真实Go1.27.3、client-go v0.34.1、controller-runtime v0.22.3、Prometheus Go client v1.22.0；固定私有API1.34.1/etcd3.6.4，自有PID及子进程总RSS768MiB/90秒预算，先编译后启动API，不改默认PATH/GOPATH/身份/context。真实API发起转换及真实私有etcd物理版本检查；HTTPS新旧服务为真实controller-runtime转换Handler，无fake API或以status代替迁移。不安装Operator或业务镜像，不证明生产运行、任意第三方云/数据库或生产SLO。

FIXED={'go.mod': 'e90c56df94139a1757a442f3d2a221ec0ce295bfa2d043a0bab49f46b782d4b2', 'go.sum': 'fedfeab0acb96fb9a900f64ed2bf7105dde96b747f378186ce75c75365caa0a7', 'model.go': 'b65248e5c3690ce62615271dccc87d1b8ecc62988f67d8efae2a7f574fc19492', 'contract.go': '4a416683bbf969806b5049deb07ff21e5ea00ef1b70cbe922f1a4184e1bc35c7'}
NEED_API=True
import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,re,signal,subprocess,sys,time
sys.path.insert(0,'checks')
from bounded_api import BoundedCluster
ROOT=pathlib.Path.cwd()
for name,digest in FIXED.items():
 assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,'fixed material modified: '+name
native=pathlib.Path('/tmp/opsforge-s05-operator-batch004-20261029')
if not (native/'gomodcache/k8s.io/client-go@v0.34.1').is_dir():raise RuntimeError('fixed native client-go module cache missing')
env=dict(os.environ,GOMODCACHE=str(native/'gomodcache'),GOCACHE=str(native/'gocache'),GOPROXY='off',GOTOOLCHAIN='local',GOMAXPROCS='2',GOMEMLIMIT='128MiB',CGO_ENABLED='0')
(ROOT/'native-tmp').mkdir(exist_ok=True);env['TMPDIR']=str(ROOT/'native-tmp')
from bounded_api import Budget
# Compile against the fixed real modules before starting native servers. This
# keeps compiler RSS and API RSS from unnecessarily overlapping; neither budget
# is relaxed. No application source is generated or changed during validation.
with Budget() as compile_budget:
 with (ROOT/'go-compile.log').open('wb') as log:
  compile_proc=subprocess.Popen(['go','test','-mod=readonly','-c','-o',str(ROOT/'native-tests'),'.'],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env=env,start_new_session=True)
  compile_budget.watch(compile_proc,group=True)
  while compile_proc.poll() is None:compile_budget.check();time.sleep(.03)
  compile_budget.check()
 if compile_proc.returncode:raise RuntimeError('native compilation failed: '+(ROOT/'go-compile.log').read_text()[-3000:])
def execute(budget):
 with (ROOT/'go-native.log').open('wb') as log:
  proc=subprocess.Popen(['go','tool','test2json','-t','-p','opsforge.local/operatorbatch004',str(ROOT/'native-tests'),'-test.count=1','-test.timeout=65s','-test.v=test2json'],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env=env,start_new_session=True)
  budget.watch(proc,group=True)
  while proc.poll() is None:
   budget.check();time.sleep(.03)
  budget.check()
 text=(ROOT/'go-native.log').read_text();print(text)
 if proc.returncode and '--- FAIL:' not in text and 'panic: IMPLEMENT_NATIVE_OPERATION' not in text:raise RuntimeError('native build/tool/checker error: '+text[-3000:])
 assert proc.returncode==0,'native semantic tests failed'
 expected=set(re.findall(r'^func (Test\w+)\(', (ROOT/'native_test.go').read_text(),re.M))
 events=[json.loads(line) for line in text.splitlines() if line.startswith('{')]
 passed={e.get('Test') for e in events if e.get('Action')=='pass' and e.get('Test')}
 assert expected and expected<=passed,'native tests did not all complete; early exit is not success'
if NEED_API:
 with BoundedCluster() as cluster:
  env['OPSF_PRIVATE_CONFIG']=cluster.config('admin');env['OPSF_ETCD_URL']='http://127.0.0.1:'+str(cluster.etcd_port);execute(cluster.budget)
else:
 with Budget() as budget:execute(budget)
print('NATIVE_OPERATOR_B004_COMPLETE')

"""Private native API fixture: real etcd and kube-apiserver, no kubeconfig changes."""
import base64
import contextlib
import http.client
import json
import os
import pathlib
import secrets
import socket
import ssl
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time


def free_port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


class Cluster:
    def __init__(self, encryption=None):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-s05-operator-b004-api-')
        self.root = pathlib.Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.processes = []
        self.api_name = 'apiserver'
        self.encryption_path = self.root/'encryption.json'
        self.port, self.etcd_port, self.peer_port = free_port(), free_port(), free_port()
        self.url = 'https://127.0.0.1:' + str(self.port)
        self.run('openssl', 'ecparam', '-name', 'prime256v1', '-genkey', '-noout', '-out', str(self.root/'ca.key'))
        self.run('openssl', 'req', '-x509', '-new', '-key', str(self.root/'ca.key'), '-out', str(self.root/'ca.crt'), '-days', '1', '-subj', '/CN=opsforge-pilot-private-ca')
        self.identity('server', 'localhost', extensions='subjectAltName=IP:127.0.0.1\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\n')
        self.identity('admin', 'opsforge-pilot-admin', 'system:masters')
        self.identity('learner', 'opsforge-pilot-user')
        (self.root/'encryption.json').write_text(json.dumps(encryption or {'apiVersion':'apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1','kind':'EncryptionConfiguration','resources':[{'resources':['secrets'],'providers':[{'identity':{}}]}]}))
        self.etcd = self.spawn('etcd', ['etcd', '--name=pilot', '--data-dir='+str(self.root/'data'), '--listen-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--advertise-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--listen-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-advertise-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-cluster=pilot=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--quota-backend-bytes=67108864', '--logger=zap', '--log-level=error'])
        self.wait_etcd()
        self.start_api()

    def run(self, *args):
        return subprocess.run(args, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)

    def identity(self, name, cn, org=None, extensions='extendedKeyUsage=clientAuth\n'):
        key, csr, crt = [self.root/(name+suffix) for suffix in ('.key','.csr','.crt')]
        self.run('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',str(key))
        self.run('openssl','req','-new','-key',str(key),'-out',str(csr),'-subj','/CN='+cn+('/O='+org if org else ''))
        ext=self.root/(name+'.ext');ext.write_text(extensions)
        self.run('openssl','x509','-req','-in',str(csr),'-CA',str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'-CAkey',str(self.root/'ca.key'),'-CAcreateserial','-out',str(crt),'-days','1','-extfile',str(ext))
        return name

    def spawn(self, name, args):
        handle=(self.root/(name+'.log')).open('ab')
        proc=subprocess.Popen(args,env={**os.environ,"GOMAXPROCS":"2","GOMEMLIMIT":"256MiB"},stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=handle,stderr=handle)
        handle.close();self.processes.append(proc)
        return proc

    def wait_etcd(self):
        for _ in range(120):
            try:
                conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=.3)
                conn.request('GET','/health');response=conn.getresponse();response.read();conn.close()
                if response.status==200:return
            except OSError:pass
            if self.etcd.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/'etcd.log').read_text())
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real etcd startup timed out')

    def start_api(self):
        self.api=self.spawn(self.api_name,['kube-apiserver','--bind-address=127.0.0.1','--advertise-address=127.0.0.1','--secure-port='+str(self.port),'--etcd-servers=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port),'--tls-cert-file='+str(self.root/'server.crt'),'--tls-private-key-file='+str(self.root/'server.key'),'--client-ca-file='+str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC','--enable-admission-plugins=NodeRestriction','--disable-admission-plugins=ServiceAccount','--anonymous-auth=false','--service-cluster-ip-range=10.240.0.0/24','--service-account-issuer=https://kubernetes.default.svc','--service-account-signing-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--service-account-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--encryption-provider-config='+str(self.encryption_path),'--profiling=false','--v=0'])
        for _ in range(240):
            try:
                code,_=self.request('GET','/readyz')
                if code==200:return
            except (OSError,ssl.SSLError,http.client.HTTPException):pass
            if self.api.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/(self.api_name+'.log')).read_text()[-10000:])
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real kube-apiserver startup timed out')

    def restart_api(self, encryption):
        self.api.terminate();self.api.wait(timeout=10)
        self.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        self.start_api()

    def peer(self, encryption):
        peer=object.__new__(Cluster)
        peer.root=self.root
        peer.processes=[]
        peer.port=free_port();peer.etcd_port=self.etcd_port
        peer.url='https://127.0.0.1:'+str(peer.port)
        peer.api_name='apiserver-peer-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
        peer.encryption_path=self.root/(peer.api_name+'.json')
        peer.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        peer.start_api()
        return peer

    def config(self, identity='learner'):
        result={'server':self.url,'ca':str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'cert':str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),'key':str(self.root/(identity+'.key'))}
        target=self.root/(identity+'-client.json');target.write_text(json.dumps(result))
        return str(target)

    def request(self, method, path, data=None, identity='admin', content_type='application/json'):
        context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(self.root/'ca.crt'))
        context.load_cert_chain(str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),str(self.root/(identity+'.key')))
        conn=http.client.HTTPSConnection('127.0.0.1',self.port,context=context,timeout=5)
        body=json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None
        conn.request(method,path,body=body,headers={'Content-Type':content_type})
        response=conn.getresponse();raw=response.read();code=response.status;conn.close()
        try:return code,json.loads(raw)
        except ValueError:return code,raw.decode(errors='replace')

    def create(self, path, obj):
        code,value=self.request('POST',path,obj)
        assert code==201,(code,value)
        return value

    def namespace(self, name):
        return self.create('/api/v1/namespaces',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Namespace','metadata':{'name':name}})

    def etcd_value(self, key):
        conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=5)
        conn.request('POST','/v3/kv/range',json.dumps({'key':base64.b64encode(key.encode()).decode()}),{'Content-Type':'application/json'})
        response=conn.getresponse();result=json.loads(response.read());conn.close()
        assert response.status==200,result
        return base64.b64decode(result['kvs'][0]['value'])

    def close(self):
        for proc in reversed(self.processes):
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.terminate()
                try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait()
        if hasattr(self,'tmp'):self.tmp.cleanup()

    def __enter__(self):return self
    def __exit__(self,*args):self.close()


if __name__=='__main__':
    started=time.monotonic()
    with Cluster() as cluster:
        print(json.dumps({'ready':cluster.request('GET','/readyz'),'version':cluster.request('GET','/version'),'seconds':time.monotonic()-started}),flush=True)

## 环境与初始材料
固定Go module/sum、公开类型和可信原生检查。仅编辑task.go。

## 操作任务
实现Configuration和Handle，使用真实ValidatingWebhookConfiguration及controller-runtime admission.Handler。仅指定namespace标签的ConfigMap CREATE/UPDATE；sideEffects=None、timeout=1s、failurePolicy=Fail、AdmissionReview v1。Handle只做有限JSON校验，data.unsafe=="true"拒绝UnsafeConfig，其余允许，禁止同步写回同类对象、额外副作用或修改有效对象。真实API注册HTTPS webhook，验证允许/拒绝/dry-run不持久化/没有额外同类对象、有效对象字段未变，关闭真实端点后Fail拒绝写入。生产业务协调仍交控制器；本题不声称在现有业务集群安装任何webhook。

## 产物
task.go

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；真实Go test2json可信Test完成事件，禁止以零退出或未执行测试冒充通过。

## 能力边界
真实Go1.27.3、client-go v0.34.1、controller-runtime v0.22.3、Prometheus Go client v1.22.0；固定私有API1.34.1/etcd3.6.4，自有PID及子进程总RSS768MiB/90秒预算，先编译后启动API，不改默认PATH/GOPATH/身份/context。实际API发起的HTTPS AdmissionReview及原生failurePolicy/dry-run；无手造Admission请求代替主链。不安装Operator或业务镜像，不证明生产运行、任意第三方云/数据库或生产SLO。
