"""Private native API fixture: real etcd and kube-apiserver, no kubeconfig changes."""
import base64
import contextlib
import http.client
import json
import os
import pathlib
import secrets
import socket
import ssl
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time


def free_port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


class Cluster:
    def __init__(self, encryption=None):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-s05-operator-b005-api-')
        self.root = pathlib.Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.processes = []
        self.api_name = 'apiserver'
        self.encryption_path = self.root/'encryption.json'
        self.port, self.etcd_port, self.peer_port = free_port(), free_port(), free_port()
        self.url = 'https://127.0.0.1:' + str(self.port)
        self.run('openssl', 'ecparam', '-name', 'prime256v1', '-genkey', '-noout', '-out', str(self.root/'ca.key'))
        self.run('openssl', 'req', '-x509', '-new', '-key', str(self.root/'ca.key'), '-out', str(self.root/'ca.crt'), '-days', '1', '-subj', '/CN=opsforge-pilot-private-ca')
        self.identity('server', 'localhost', extensions='subjectAltName=IP:127.0.0.1\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\n')
        self.identity('admin', 'opsforge-pilot-admin', 'system:masters')
        self.identity('learner', 'opsforge-pilot-user')
        (self.root/'encryption.json').write_text(json.dumps(encryption or {'apiVersion':'apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1','kind':'EncryptionConfiguration','resources':[{'resources':['secrets'],'providers':[{'identity':{}}]}]}))
        self.etcd = self.spawn('etcd', ['etcd', '--name=pilot', '--data-dir='+str(self.root/'data'), '--listen-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--advertise-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--listen-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-advertise-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-cluster=pilot=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--quota-backend-bytes=67108864', '--logger=zap', '--log-level=error'])
        self.wait_etcd()
        self.start_api()

    def run(self, *args):
        return subprocess.run(args, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)

    def identity(self, name, cn, org=None, extensions='extendedKeyUsage=clientAuth\n'):
        key, csr, crt = [self.root/(name+suffix) for suffix in ('.key','.csr','.crt')]
        self.run('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',str(key))
        self.run('openssl','req','-new','-key',str(key),'-out',str(csr),'-subj','/CN='+cn+('/O='+org if org else ''))
        ext=self.root/(name+'.ext');ext.write_text(extensions)
        self.run('openssl','x509','-req','-in',str(csr),'-CA',str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'-CAkey',str(self.root/'ca.key'),'-CAcreateserial','-out',str(crt),'-days','1','-extfile',str(ext))
        return name

    def spawn(self, name, args):
        handle=(self.root/(name+'.log')).open('ab')
        proc=subprocess.Popen(args,env={**os.environ,"GOMAXPROCS":"2","GOMEMLIMIT":"256MiB"},stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=handle,stderr=handle)
        handle.close();self.processes.append(proc)
        return proc

    def wait_etcd(self):
        for _ in range(120):
            try:
                conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=.3)
                conn.request('GET','/health');response=conn.getresponse();response.read();conn.close()
                if response.status==200:return
            except OSError:pass
            if self.etcd.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/'etcd.log').read_text())
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real etcd startup timed out')

    def start_api(self):
        self.api=self.spawn(self.api_name,['kube-apiserver','--bind-address=127.0.0.1','--advertise-address=127.0.0.1','--secure-port='+str(self.port),'--etcd-servers=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port),'--tls-cert-file='+str(self.root/'server.crt'),'--tls-private-key-file='+str(self.root/'server.key'),'--client-ca-file='+str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC','--enable-admission-plugins=NodeRestriction','--disable-admission-plugins=ServiceAccount','--anonymous-auth=false','--service-cluster-ip-range=10.240.0.0/24','--service-account-issuer=https://kubernetes.default.svc','--service-account-signing-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--service-account-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--encryption-provider-config='+str(self.encryption_path),'--profiling=false','--v=0'])
        for _ in range(240):
            try:
                code,_=self.request('GET','/readyz')
                if code==200:return
            except (OSError,ssl.SSLError,http.client.HTTPException):pass
            if self.api.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/(self.api_name+'.log')).read_text()[-10000:])
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real kube-apiserver startup timed out')

    def restart_api(self, encryption):
        self.api.terminate();self.api.wait(timeout=10)
        self.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        self.start_api()

    def peer(self, encryption):
        peer=object.__new__(Cluster)
        peer.root=self.root
        peer.processes=[]
        peer.port=free_port();peer.etcd_port=self.etcd_port
        peer.url='https://127.0.0.1:'+str(peer.port)
        peer.api_name='apiserver-peer-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
        peer.encryption_path=self.root/(peer.api_name+'.json')
        peer.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        peer.start_api()
        return peer

    def config(self, identity='learner'):
        result={'server':self.url,'ca':str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'cert':str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),'key':str(self.root/(identity+'.key'))}
        target=self.root/(identity+'-client.json');target.write_text(json.dumps(result))
        return str(target)

    def request(self, method, path, data=None, identity='admin', content_type='application/json'):
        context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(self.root/'ca.crt'))
        context.load_cert_chain(str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),str(self.root/(identity+'.key')))
        conn=http.client.HTTPSConnection('127.0.0.1',self.port,context=context,timeout=5)
        body=json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None
        conn.request(method,path,body=body,headers={'Content-Type':content_type})
        response=conn.getresponse();raw=response.read();code=response.status;conn.close()
        try:return code,json.loads(raw)
        except ValueError:return code,raw.decode(errors='replace')

    def create(self, path, obj):
        code,value=self.request('POST',path,obj)
        assert code==201,(code,value)
        return value

    def namespace(self, name):
        return self.create('/api/v1/namespaces',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Namespace','metadata':{'name':name}})

    def etcd_value(self, key):
        conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=5)
        conn.request('POST','/v3/kv/range',json.dumps({'key':base64.b64encode(key.encode()).decode()}),{'Content-Type':'application/json'})
        response=conn.getresponse();result=json.loads(response.read());conn.close()
        assert response.status==200,result
        return base64.b64decode(result['kvs'][0]['value'])

    def close(self):
        for proc in reversed(self.processes):
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.terminate()
                try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait()
        if hasattr(self,'tmp'):self.tmp.cleanup()

    def __enter__(self):return self
    def __exit__(self,*args):self.close()


if __name__=='__main__':
    started=time.monotonic()
    with Cluster() as cluster:
        print(json.dumps({'ready':cluster.request('GET','/readyz'),'version':cluster.request('GET','/version'),'seconds':time.monotonic()-started}),flush=True)

## 环境与初始材料
固定Go模块及真实私有API；仅编辑task.go和design.json，其他材料不改。

## 操作任务
实现明确的per-CR pause合同：暂停时冻结子ConfigMap创建/更新/删除，但继续读取并在status.phase=Paused及observedGeneration报告当前代数；多次暂停spec变化不会回滚或写子对象。恢复后对账最新spec，其他CR继续工作。删除策略明确为暂停时保留本题专用finalizer和子对象、phase=PausedDeletion；取消pause后仅按UID删除自己子对象并移除该finalizer，真实API完成CR删除。此finalizer是本题暂停删除策略，不套用于无外部清理需求的WebApp示例；不声称暂停等于停进程或自动回退。

## 产物
task.go
design.json语义映射：{"scope": "per-cr-not-controller-process", "paused_child_writes": "none", "paused_status": "current-generation-visible", "resume": "reconcile-latest-intent", "delete_while_paused": "hold-finalizer-and-child", "delete_after_resume": "uid-guarded-own-child-then-finalizer"}

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py。真实controller-runtime循环及API对象状态变化，参考/未完成/错解/合法替代/原生提前退出分别验证。

## 能力边界
真实Go控制器/工作队列及私有Kubernetes1.34.1 API/etcd3.6.4；独立CA和临时资源，自有PID RSS768MiB/90s预算，默认身份/PATH/GOPATH/context不变。不安装业务或Operator镜像，不声称Pod运行、生产SLO或完整模块验收。

REQUIRED_PLAN={'scope': 'per-cr-not-controller-process', 'paused_child_writes': 'none', 'paused_status': 'current-generation-visible', 'resume': 'reconcile-latest-intent', 'delete_while_paused': 'hold-finalizer-and-child', 'delete_after_resume': 'uid-guarded-own-child-then-finalizer'}
GO_MOD_ARGS=[]
NEED_API=True
import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,re,signal,subprocess,sys,time
sys.path.insert(0,'checks')
from bounded_api import BoundedCluster
ROOT=pathlib.Path.cwd()
for name,digest in FIXED.items():
 assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,'fixed material modified: '+name
plan=json.loads((ROOT/'design.json').read_text())
for key,value in REQUIRED_PLAN.items():assert plan.get(key)==value,'design contract: '+key
native=pathlib.Path('/tmp/opsforge-s05-operator-batch002-20261029')
if not (native/'gomodcache/k8s.io/client-go@v0.34.1').is_dir():raise RuntimeError('fixed native client-go module cache missing')
env=dict(os.environ,GOMODCACHE=str(native/'gomodcache'),GOCACHE=str(native/'gocache'),GOPROXY='off',GOTOOLCHAIN='local',GOMAXPROCS='2',GOMEMLIMIT='128MiB',CGO_ENABLED='0')
(ROOT/'native-tmp').mkdir(exist_ok=True);env['TMPDIR']=str(ROOT/'native-tmp')
from bounded_api import Budget
# Compile against the fixed real modules before starting native servers. This
# keeps compiler RSS and API RSS from unnecessarily overlapping; neither budget
# is relaxed. No application source is generated or changed during validation.
with Budget() as compile_budget:
 with (ROOT/'go-compile.log').open('wb') as log:
  compile_proc=subprocess.Popen(['go','test','-mod=readonly',*GO_MOD_ARGS,'-ldflags=-s -w','-c','-o',str(ROOT/'native-tests'),'.'],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env=env,start_new_session=True)
  compile_budget.watch(compile_proc,group=True)
  while compile_proc.poll() is None:compile_budget.check();time.sleep(.03)
  compile_budget.check()
 if compile_proc.returncode:raise RuntimeError('native compilation failed: '+(ROOT/'go-compile.log').read_text()[-3000:])
def execute(budget):
 with (ROOT/'go-native.log').open('wb') as log:
  proc=subprocess.Popen(['go','tool','test2json','-t','-p','opsforge.local/operatorbatch005',str(ROOT/'native-tests'),'-test.count=1','-test.timeout=45s','-test.v=test2json'],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env=env,start_new_session=True)
  budget.watch(proc,group=True)
  while proc.poll() is None:
   budget.check();time.sleep(.03)
  budget.check()
 text=(ROOT/'go-native.log').read_text();print(text)
 if proc.returncode and '--- FAIL:' not in text and 'panic: IMPLEMENT_NATIVE_OPERATION' not in text:raise RuntimeError('native build/tool/checker error: '+text[-3000:])
 assert proc.returncode==0,'native semantic tests failed'
 expected={name for p in ROOT.glob('*_test.go') for name in re.findall(r'^func (Test\w+)\(',p.read_text(),re.M)}
 events=[json.loads(line) for line in text.splitlines() if line.startswith('{')]
 passed={e.get('Test') for e in events if e.get('Action')=='pass' and e.get('Test')}
 assert expected and expected<=passed,'native tests did not all complete; early exit is not success'
if NEED_API:
 with BoundedCluster() as cluster:
  env['OPSF_PRIVATE_CONFIG']=cluster.config('admin');execute(cluster.budget)
else:
 with Budget() as budget:execute(budget)
print('NATIVE_OPERATOR_B002_COMPLETE')

"""Private native API fixture: real etcd and kube-apiserver, no kubeconfig changes."""
import base64
import contextlib
import http.client
import json
import os
import pathlib
import secrets
import socket
import ssl
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time


def free_port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


class Cluster:
    def __init__(self, encryption=None):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-s05-operator-b005-api-')
        self.root = pathlib.Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.processes = []
        self.api_name = 'apiserver'
        self.encryption_path = self.root/'encryption.json'
        self.port, self.etcd_port, self.peer_port = free_port(), free_port(), free_port()
        self.url = 'https://127.0.0.1:' + str(self.port)
        self.run('openssl', 'ecparam', '-name', 'prime256v1', '-genkey', '-noout', '-out', str(self.root/'ca.key'))
        self.run('openssl', 'req', '-x509', '-new', '-key', str(self.root/'ca.key'), '-out', str(self.root/'ca.crt'), '-days', '1', '-subj', '/CN=opsforge-pilot-private-ca')
        self.identity('server', 'localhost', extensions='subjectAltName=IP:127.0.0.1\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\n')
        self.identity('admin', 'opsforge-pilot-admin', 'system:masters')
        self.identity('learner', 'opsforge-pilot-user')
        (self.root/'encryption.json').write_text(json.dumps(encryption or {'apiVersion':'apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1','kind':'EncryptionConfiguration','resources':[{'resources':['secrets'],'providers':[{'identity':{}}]}]}))
        self.etcd = self.spawn('etcd', ['etcd', '--name=pilot', '--data-dir='+str(self.root/'data'), '--listen-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--advertise-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--listen-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-advertise-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-cluster=pilot=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--quota-backend-bytes=67108864', '--logger=zap', '--log-level=error'])
        self.wait_etcd()
        self.start_api()

    def run(self, *args):
        return subprocess.run(args, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)

    def identity(self, name, cn, org=None, extensions='extendedKeyUsage=clientAuth\n'):
        key, csr, crt = [self.root/(name+suffix) for suffix in ('.key','.csr','.crt')]
        self.run('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',str(key))
        self.run('openssl','req','-new','-key',str(key),'-out',str(csr),'-subj','/CN='+cn+('/O='+org if org else ''))
        ext=self.root/(name+'.ext');ext.write_text(extensions)
        self.run('openssl','x509','-req','-in',str(csr),'-CA',str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'-CAkey',str(self.root/'ca.key'),'-CAcreateserial','-out',str(crt),'-days','1','-extfile',str(ext))
        return name

    def spawn(self, name, args):
        handle=(self.root/(name+'.log')).open('ab')
        proc=subprocess.Popen(args,env={**os.environ,"GOMAXPROCS":"2","GOMEMLIMIT":"256MiB"},stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=handle,stderr=handle)
        handle.close();self.processes.append(proc)
        return proc

    def wait_etcd(self):
        for _ in range(120):
            try:
                conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=.3)
                conn.request('GET','/health');response=conn.getresponse();response.read();conn.close()
                if response.status==200:return
            except OSError:pass
            if self.etcd.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/'etcd.log').read_text())
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real etcd startup timed out')

    def start_api(self):
        self.api=self.spawn(self.api_name,['kube-apiserver','--bind-address=127.0.0.1','--advertise-address=127.0.0.1','--secure-port='+str(self.port),'--etcd-servers=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port),'--tls-cert-file='+str(self.root/'server.crt'),'--tls-private-key-file='+str(self.root/'server.key'),'--client-ca-file='+str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC','--enable-admission-plugins=NodeRestriction','--disable-admission-plugins=ServiceAccount','--anonymous-auth=false','--service-cluster-ip-range=10.240.0.0/24','--service-account-issuer=https://kubernetes.default.svc','--service-account-signing-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--service-account-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--encryption-provider-config='+str(self.encryption_path),'--profiling=false','--v=0'])
        for _ in range(240):
            try:
                code,_=self.request('GET','/readyz')
                if code==200:return
            except (OSError,ssl.SSLError,http.client.HTTPException):pass
            if self.api.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/(self.api_name+'.log')).read_text()[-10000:])
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real kube-apiserver startup timed out')

    def restart_api(self, encryption):
        self.api.terminate();self.api.wait(timeout=10)
        self.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        self.start_api()

    def peer(self, encryption):
        peer=object.__new__(Cluster)
        peer.root=self.root
        peer.processes=[]
        peer.port=free_port();peer.etcd_port=self.etcd_port
        peer.url='https://127.0.0.1:'+str(peer.port)
        peer.api_name='apiserver-peer-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
        peer.encryption_path=self.root/(peer.api_name+'.json')
        peer.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        peer.start_api()
        return peer

    def config(self, identity='learner'):
        result={'server':self.url,'ca':str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'cert':str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),'key':str(self.root/(identity+'.key'))}
        target=self.root/(identity+'-client.json');target.write_text(json.dumps(result))
        return str(target)

    def request(self, method, path, data=None, identity='admin', content_type='application/json'):
        context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(self.root/'ca.crt'))
        context.load_cert_chain(str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),str(self.root/(identity+'.key')))
        conn=http.client.HTTPSConnection('127.0.0.1',self.port,context=context,timeout=5)
        body=json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None
        conn.request(method,path,body=body,headers={'Content-Type':content_type})
        response=conn.getresponse();raw=response.read();code=response.status;conn.close()
        try:return code,json.loads(raw)
        except ValueError:return code,raw.decode(errors='replace')

    def create(self, path, obj):
        code,value=self.request('POST',path,obj)
        assert code==201,(code,value)
        return value

    def namespace(self, name):
        return self.create('/api/v1/namespaces',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Namespace','metadata':{'name':name}})

    def etcd_value(self, key):
        conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=5)
        conn.request('POST','/v3/kv/range',json.dumps({'key':base64.b64encode(key.encode()).decode()}),{'Content-Type':'application/json'})
        response=conn.getresponse();result=json.loads(response.read());conn.close()
        assert response.status==200,result
        return base64.b64decode(result['kvs'][0]['value'])

    def close(self):
        for proc in reversed(self.processes):
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.terminate()
                try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait()
        if hasattr(self,'tmp'):self.tmp.cleanup()

    def __enter__(self):return self
    def __exit__(self,*args):self.close()


if __name__=='__main__':
    started=time.monotonic()
    with Cluster() as cluster:
        print(json.dumps({'ready':cluster.request('GET','/readyz'),'version':cluster.request('GET','/version'),'seconds':time.monotonic()-started}),flush=True)

files.README.md:
# WebApp 小型参考控制器

范围：单进程、单 namespace 的学习控制器；不是 Kubebuilder 脚手架，也不是高可用生产发行版。Go module 基线 go1.23.0，controller-runtime v0.20.4，Kubernetes Go API v0.32.1；使用项目 go.mod/go.sum 锁定实际依赖。

## 已实现的合同

WebApp 名称须为可用的 DNS1035 Service 名。image 非空，replicas 为 0–10，port 为 1–65535。镜像本身必须在 port 监听，设置 containerPort 不会修改应用配置。仅管理同 namespace 同名 Deployment/ClusterIP Service，selector 使用 CR UID；不接管其他 owner 的对象，不迁移不可变 selector 或 Service 类型。

写入前直接读 APIReader；Update/Status Update 遇 Conflict 重读后有限重试，Create AlreadyExists 返回工作队列重试而不绕过所有权检查。每次只修改控制器拥有的字段，保留 Service 分配地址和 Pod 默认字段。CR 代数或 UID 改变时拒绝把旧观测写成新状态。Ready 要求 Deployment 已观测当前代数且 updated/ready/available/total 副本都满足目标；该 Ready 是工作负载控制面合同，不等于 HTTP 业务 SLO。没有默认添加业务探针，因为题目未指定可用的健康协议。

本题没有外部云资源，因此不添加自定义 finalizer；删除靠合法 OwnerReference 及 Kubernetes 垃圾回收。进程发现 CR 正在删除时不再创建子资源。多副本控制器需要另行补 leader election、Lease 权限及故障测试；本答案只运行一个实例。

## 本地检查

先保存全部文件，在本目录执行：

```text
go mod download
go test -mod=readonly -count=1 -v ./...
go build -mod=readonly ./...
```

fake client 测试只验证对象级逻辑，包括重复协调不写入、拒绝接管、代数检查、冲突重试。它不会运行 Deployment controller、自动分配 Service IP 或垃圾回收，也不会证明 CRD 准入与 RBAC 正确；测试为这些服务器字段设置显式样本。

## 可选隔离集群验收（与单元测试分开）

以下命令仅对自行准备的 Kubernetes 1.32 系列隔离集群执行；本题交付不声称已实际运行它们。管理员先安装 CRD、namespace 与 Role；控制器进程使用具备对应 namespace 权限的 kubeconfig。RoleBinding 给出的 ServiceAccount 仅用于使用该身份的部署，go run 默认使用当前 kubeconfig 身份，不会自动切换到 ServiceAccount。

```text
kubectl apply -f crd.json
kubectl wait --for=condition=Established --timeout=60s crd/webapps.lab.opsforge.dev
kubectl apply -f namespace-rbac.json
go run ./cmd/controller --namespace opsforge-lab
```

保持控制器运行，另一个终端执行：

```text
kubectl apply -f sample.json
kubectl -n opsforge-lab get webapp demo -o yaml
kubectl -n opsforge-lab get deployment demo -o yaml
kubectl -n opsforge-lab get service demo -o yaml
kubectl -n opsforge-lab rollout status deployment/demo --timeout=120s
kubectl -n opsforge-lab port-forward service/demo 18080:8080
```

另一个终端访问 http://127.0.0.1:18080，记录实际返回。镜像标签只是学习样例，真实发布须按已验证摘要固定。核验 CR 与子对象 owner UID、Service ClusterIP；重复提交相同 spec 后不应不断写 status。修改 replicas/image 时核对新 generation；新镜像不能就绪时不得继续报旧 Ready。停止/重启控制器确认已建对象不重复；创建同名但不同 owner 的对象应报冲突并保留原物。删除 demo 后单独验证 API 垃圾回收，不能从 fake client 测试推断此项已通过。

失败时先停止此学习控制器并保留 CR、子对象和日志；不批量改 owner/finalizer，不删除其他工作负载。没有卷或外部资源的数据恢复逻辑，禁止将该示例直接套用于数据库 Operator。

"""Private native API fixture: real etcd and kube-apiserver, no kubeconfig changes."""
import base64
import contextlib
import http.client
import json
import os
import pathlib
import secrets
import socket
import ssl
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time


def free_port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


class Cluster:
    def __init__(self, encryption=None):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-s05-operator-b005-api-')
        self.root = pathlib.Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.processes = []
        self.api_name = 'apiserver'
        self.encryption_path = self.root/'encryption.json'
        self.port, self.etcd_port, self.peer_port = free_port(), free_port(), free_port()
        self.url = 'https://127.0.0.1:' + str(self.port)
        self.run('openssl', 'ecparam', '-name', 'prime256v1', '-genkey', '-noout', '-out', str(self.root/'ca.key'))
        self.run('openssl', 'req', '-x509', '-new', '-key', str(self.root/'ca.key'), '-out', str(self.root/'ca.crt'), '-days', '1', '-subj', '/CN=opsforge-pilot-private-ca')
        self.identity('server', 'localhost', extensions='subjectAltName=IP:127.0.0.1\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\n')
        self.identity('admin', 'opsforge-pilot-admin', 'system:masters')
        self.identity('learner', 'opsforge-pilot-user')
        (self.root/'encryption.json').write_text(json.dumps(encryption or {'apiVersion':'apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1','kind':'EncryptionConfiguration','resources':[{'resources':['secrets'],'providers':[{'identity':{}}]}]}))
        self.etcd = self.spawn('etcd', ['etcd', '--name=pilot', '--data-dir='+str(self.root/'data'), '--listen-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--advertise-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--listen-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-advertise-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-cluster=pilot=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--quota-backend-bytes=67108864', '--logger=zap', '--log-level=error'])
        self.wait_etcd()
        self.start_api()

    def run(self, *args):
        return subprocess.run(args, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)

    def identity(self, name, cn, org=None, extensions='extendedKeyUsage=clientAuth\n'):
        key, csr, crt = [self.root/(name+suffix) for suffix in ('.key','.csr','.crt')]
        self.run('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',str(key))
        self.run('openssl','req','-new','-key',str(key),'-out',str(csr),'-subj','/CN='+cn+('/O='+org if org else ''))
        ext=self.root/(name+'.ext');ext.write_text(extensions)
        self.run('openssl','x509','-req','-in',str(csr),'-CA',str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'-CAkey',str(self.root/'ca.key'),'-CAcreateserial','-out',str(crt),'-days','1','-extfile',str(ext))
        return name

    def spawn(self, name, args):
        handle=(self.root/(name+'.log')).open('ab')
        proc=subprocess.Popen(args,env={**os.environ,"GOMAXPROCS":"2","GOMEMLIMIT":"256MiB"},stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=handle,stderr=handle)
        handle.close();self.processes.append(proc)
        return proc

    def wait_etcd(self):
        for _ in range(120):
            try:
                conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=.3)
                conn.request('GET','/health');response=conn.getresponse();response.read();conn.close()
                if response.status==200:return
            except OSError:pass
            if self.etcd.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/'etcd.log').read_text())
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real etcd startup timed out')

    def start_api(self):
        self.api=self.spawn(self.api_name,['kube-apiserver','--bind-address=127.0.0.1','--advertise-address=127.0.0.1','--secure-port='+str(self.port),'--etcd-servers=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port),'--tls-cert-file='+str(self.root/'server.crt'),'--tls-private-key-file='+str(self.root/'server.key'),'--client-ca-file='+str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC','--enable-admission-plugins=NodeRestriction','--disable-admission-plugins=ServiceAccount','--anonymous-auth=false','--service-cluster-ip-range=10.240.0.0/24','--service-account-issuer=https://kubernetes.default.svc','--service-account-signing-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--service-account-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--encryption-provider-config='+str(self.encryption_path),'--profiling=false','--v=0'])
        for _ in range(240):
            try:
                code,_=self.request('GET','/readyz')
                if code==200:return
            except (OSError,ssl.SSLError,http.client.HTTPException):pass
            if self.api.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/(self.api_name+'.log')).read_text()[-10000:])
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real kube-apiserver startup timed out')

    def restart_api(self, encryption):
        self.api.terminate();self.api.wait(timeout=10)
        self.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        self.start_api()

    def peer(self, encryption):
        peer=object.__new__(Cluster)
        peer.root=self.root
        peer.processes=[]
        peer.port=free_port();peer.etcd_port=self.etcd_port
        peer.url='https://127.0.0.1:'+str(peer.port)
        peer.api_name='apiserver-peer-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
        peer.encryption_path=self.root/(peer.api_name+'.json')
        peer.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        peer.start_api()
        return peer

    def config(self, identity='learner'):
        result={'server':self.url,'ca':str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'cert':str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),'key':str(self.root/(identity+'.key'))}
        target=self.root/(identity+'-client.json');target.write_text(json.dumps(result))
        return str(target)

    def request(self, method, path, data=None, identity='admin', content_type='application/json'):
        context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(self.root/'ca.crt'))
        context.load_cert_chain(str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),str(self.root/(identity+'.key')))
        conn=http.client.HTTPSConnection('127.0.0.1',self.port,context=context,timeout=5)
        body=json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None
        conn.request(method,path,body=body,headers={'Content-Type':content_type})
        response=conn.getresponse();raw=response.read();code=response.status;conn.close()
        try:return code,json.loads(raw)
        except ValueError:return code,raw.decode(errors='replace')

    def create(self, path, obj):
        code,value=self.request('POST',path,obj)
        assert code==201,(code,value)
        return value

    def namespace(self, name):
        return self.create('/api/v1/namespaces',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Namespace','metadata':{'name':name}})

    def etcd_value(self, key):
        conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=5)
        conn.request('POST','/v3/kv/range',json.dumps({'key':base64.b64encode(key.encode()).decode()}),{'Content-Type':'application/json'})
        response=conn.getresponse();result=json.loads(response.read());conn.close()
        assert response.status==200,result
        return base64.b64decode(result['kvs'][0]['value'])

    def close(self):
        for proc in reversed(self.processes):
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.terminate()
                try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait()
        if hasattr(self,'tmp'):self.tmp.cleanup()

    def __enter__(self):return self
    def __exit__(self,*args):self.close()


if __name__=='__main__':
    started=time.monotonic()
    with Cluster() as cluster:
        print(json.dumps({'ready':cluster.request('GET','/readyz'),'version':cluster.request('GET','/version'),'seconds':time.monotonic()-started}),flush=True)

body:
## 环境与初始材料
固定Go模块及真实私有API；仅编辑task.go和design.json，其他材料不改。

## 操作任务
实现持续RunView循环。输入断连前完整视图和旧resourceVersion。真实etcd压缩后，服务端通过watch ERROR Status410通知过期；重新list必须替换整个视图并以新RV续watch，不能依赖缺失历史；同名重建以UID区分，重复事件与重列幂等，取消及时退出。测试API关闭watch-cache以直接观察真实存储保留窗口，不冒充生产缓存配置。

## 产物
task.go
design.json语义映射：{"expired": "relist-replace-current-view", "resume": "list-resourceVersion", "identity": "namespace-name-uid", "repeated-events": "idempotent-upsert", "cancellation": "context"}

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py。真实controller-runtime循环及API对象状态变化，参考/未完成/错解/合法替代/原生提前退出分别验证。

## 能力边界
真实Go控制器/工作队列及私有Kubernetes1.34.1 API/etcd3.6.4；独立CA和临时资源，自有PID RSS768MiB/90s预算，默认身份/PATH/GOPATH/context不变。不安装业务或Operator镜像，不声称Pod运行、生产SLO或完整模块验收。

"""Private native API fixture: real etcd and kube-apiserver, no kubeconfig changes."""
import base64
import contextlib
import http.client
import json
import os
import pathlib
import secrets
import socket
import ssl
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time


def free_port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


class Cluster:
    def __init__(self, encryption=None):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-s05-operator-b006-api-')
        self.root = pathlib.Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.processes = []
        self.api_name = 'apiserver'
        self.encryption_path = self.root/'encryption.json'
        self.port, self.etcd_port, self.peer_port = free_port(), free_port(), free_port()
        self.url = 'https://127.0.0.1:' + str(self.port)
        self.run('openssl', 'ecparam', '-name', 'prime256v1', '-genkey', '-noout', '-out', str(self.root/'ca.key'))
        self.run('openssl', 'req', '-x509', '-new', '-key', str(self.root/'ca.key'), '-out', str(self.root/'ca.crt'), '-days', '1', '-subj', '/CN=opsforge-pilot-private-ca')
        self.identity('server', 'localhost', extensions='subjectAltName=IP:127.0.0.1\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\n')
        self.identity('admin', 'opsforge-pilot-admin', 'system:masters')
        self.identity('learner', 'opsforge-pilot-user')
        (self.root/'encryption.json').write_text(json.dumps(encryption or {'apiVersion':'apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1','kind':'EncryptionConfiguration','resources':[{'resources':['secrets'],'providers':[{'identity':{}}]}]}))
        self.etcd = self.spawn('etcd', ['etcd', '--name=pilot', '--data-dir='+str(self.root/'data'), '--listen-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--advertise-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--listen-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-advertise-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-cluster=pilot=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--quota-backend-bytes=67108864', '--logger=zap', '--log-level=error'])
        self.wait_etcd()
        self.start_api()

    def run(self, *args):
        return subprocess.run(args, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)

    def identity(self, name, cn, org=None, extensions='extendedKeyUsage=clientAuth\n'):
        key, csr, crt = [self.root/(name+suffix) for suffix in ('.key','.csr','.crt')]
        self.run('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',str(key))
        self.run('openssl','req','-new','-key',str(key),'-out',str(csr),'-subj','/CN='+cn+('/O='+org if org else ''))
        ext=self.root/(name+'.ext');ext.write_text(extensions)
        self.run('openssl','x509','-req','-in',str(csr),'-CA',str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'-CAkey',str(self.root/'ca.key'),'-CAcreateserial','-out',str(crt),'-days','1','-extfile',str(ext))
        return name

    def spawn(self, name, args):
        handle=(self.root/(name+'.log')).open('ab')
        proc=subprocess.Popen(args,env={**os.environ,"GOMAXPROCS":"2","GOMEMLIMIT":"256MiB"},stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=handle,stderr=handle)
        handle.close();self.processes.append(proc)
        return proc

    def wait_etcd(self):
        for _ in range(120):
            try:
                conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=.3)
                conn.request('GET','/health');response=conn.getresponse();response.read();conn.close()
                if response.status==200:return
            except OSError:pass
            if self.etcd.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/'etcd.log').read_text())
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real etcd startup timed out')

    def start_api(self):
        self.api=self.spawn(self.api_name,['kube-apiserver','--bind-address=127.0.0.1','--advertise-address=127.0.0.1','--secure-port='+str(self.port),'--etcd-servers=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port),'--tls-cert-file='+str(self.root/'server.crt'),'--tls-private-key-file='+str(self.root/'server.key'),'--client-ca-file='+str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC','--enable-admission-plugins=NodeRestriction','--disable-admission-plugins=ServiceAccount','--anonymous-auth=false','--service-cluster-ip-range=10.240.0.0/24','--service-account-issuer=https://kubernetes.default.svc','--service-account-signing-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--service-account-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--encryption-provider-config='+str(self.encryption_path),'--watch-cache=false','--profiling=false','--v=0'])
        for _ in range(240):
            try:
                code,_=self.request('GET','/readyz')
                if code==200:return
            except (OSError,ssl.SSLError,http.client.HTTPException):pass
            if self.api.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/(self.api_name+'.log')).read_text()[-10000:])
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real kube-apiserver startup timed out')

    def restart_api(self, encryption):
        self.api.terminate();self.api.wait(timeout=10)
        self.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        self.start_api()

    def peer(self, encryption):
        peer=object.__new__(Cluster)
        peer.root=self.root
        peer.processes=[]
        peer.port=free_port();peer.etcd_port=self.etcd_port
        peer.url='https://127.0.0.1:'+str(peer.port)
        peer.api_name='apiserver-peer-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
        peer.encryption_path=self.root/(peer.api_name+'.json')
        peer.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        peer.start_api()
        return peer

    def config(self, identity='learner'):
        result={'server':self.url,'ca':str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'cert':str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),'key':str(self.root/(identity+'.key'))}
        target=self.root/(identity+'-client.json');target.write_text(json.dumps(result))
        return str(target)

    def request(self, method, path, data=None, identity='admin', content_type='application/json'):
        context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(self.root/'ca.crt'))
        context.load_cert_chain(str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),str(self.root/(identity+'.key')))
        conn=http.client.HTTPSConnection('127.0.0.1',self.port,context=context,timeout=5)
        body=json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None
        conn.request(method,path,body=body,headers={'Content-Type':content_type})
        response=conn.getresponse();raw=response.read();code=response.status;conn.close()
        try:return code,json.loads(raw)
        except ValueError:return code,raw.decode(errors='replace')

    def create(self, path, obj):
        code,value=self.request('POST',path,obj)
        assert code==201,(code,value)
        return value

    def namespace(self, name):
        return self.create('/api/v1/namespaces',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Namespace','metadata':{'name':name}})

    def etcd_value(self, key):
        conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=5)
        conn.request('POST','/v3/kv/range',json.dumps({'key':base64.b64encode(key.encode()).decode()}),{'Content-Type':'application/json'})
        response=conn.getresponse();result=json.loads(response.read());conn.close()
        assert response.status==200,result
        return base64.b64decode(result['kvs'][0]['value'])

    def close(self):
        for proc in reversed(self.processes):
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.terminate()
                try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait()
        if hasattr(self,'tmp'):self.tmp.cleanup()

    def __enter__(self):return self
    def __exit__(self,*args):self.close()


if __name__=='__main__':
    started=time.monotonic()
    with Cluster() as cluster:
        print(json.dumps({'ready':cluster.request('GET','/readyz'),'version':cluster.request('GET','/version'),'seconds':time.monotonic()-started}),flush=True)

## 环境与初始材料
固定Go模块及真实私有API；仅编辑task.go和design.json，其他材料不改。

## 操作任务
实现PermissionReconciler：真实MySQL删除权限丢失时，保留本对象finalizer与所有其他finalizer，状态明确AwaitPermission且有限速重试；其他外部观测错误保持Unknown，不能强移finalizer。权限恢复后，即便进程/协调器重启，也从API和真实数据库归属记录续做同一UID的删除。原SELECT权限在叠加DROP后仍有效，只授目标库DROP，其他库不受影响。仅私有MySQL账号与临时数据库，默认身份不变。

## 产物
task.go
design.json语义映射：{"permission_loss": "hold-finalizer-clear-reason-bounded-retry", "recovery": "same-uid-restart-resume", "permission_addition": "preserve-existing-select-target-only-drop", "unknown": "not-deleted"}

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py。真实controller-runtime循环及API对象状态变化，参考/未完成/错解/合法替代/原生提前退出分别验证。

## 能力边界
真实Go控制器/工作队列及私有Kubernetes1.34.1 API/etcd3.6.4；独立CA和临时资源，自有PID RSS768MiB/90s预算，默认身份/PATH/GOPATH/context不变。不安装业务或Operator镜像，不声称Pod运行、生产SLO或完整模块验收。

"""Private native API fixture: real etcd and kube-apiserver, no kubeconfig changes."""
import base64
import contextlib
import http.client
import json
import os
import pathlib
import secrets
import socket
import ssl
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time


def free_port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


class Cluster:
    def __init__(self, encryption=None):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-s05-operator-b006-api-')
        self.root = pathlib.Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.processes = []
        self.api_name = 'apiserver'
        self.encryption_path = self.root/'encryption.json'
        self.port, self.etcd_port, self.peer_port = free_port(), free_port(), free_port()
        self.url = 'https://127.0.0.1:' + str(self.port)
        self.run('openssl', 'ecparam', '-name', 'prime256v1', '-genkey', '-noout', '-out', str(self.root/'ca.key'))
        self.run('openssl', 'req', '-x509', '-new', '-key', str(self.root/'ca.key'), '-out', str(self.root/'ca.crt'), '-days', '1', '-subj', '/CN=opsforge-pilot-private-ca')
        self.identity('server', 'localhost', extensions='subjectAltName=IP:127.0.0.1\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\n')
        self.identity('admin', 'opsforge-pilot-admin', 'system:masters')
        self.identity('learner', 'opsforge-pilot-user')
        (self.root/'encryption.json').write_text(json.dumps(encryption or {'apiVersion':'apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1','kind':'EncryptionConfiguration','resources':[{'resources':['secrets'],'providers':[{'identity':{}}]}]}))
        self.etcd = self.spawn('etcd', ['etcd', '--name=pilot', '--data-dir='+str(self.root/'data'), '--listen-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--advertise-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--listen-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-advertise-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-cluster=pilot=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--quota-backend-bytes=67108864', '--logger=zap', '--log-level=error'])
        self.wait_etcd()
        self.start_api()

    def run(self, *args):
        return subprocess.run(args, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)

    def identity(self, name, cn, org=None, extensions='extendedKeyUsage=clientAuth\n'):
        key, csr, crt = [self.root/(name+suffix) for suffix in ('.key','.csr','.crt')]
        self.run('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',str(key))
        self.run('openssl','req','-new','-key',str(key),'-out',str(csr),'-subj','/CN='+cn+('/O='+org if org else ''))
        ext=self.root/(name+'.ext');ext.write_text(extensions)
        self.run('openssl','x509','-req','-in',str(csr),'-CA',str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'-CAkey',str(self.root/'ca.key'),'-CAcreateserial','-out',str(crt),'-days','1','-extfile',str(ext))
        return name

    def spawn(self, name, args):
        handle=(self.root/(name+'.log')).open('ab')
        proc=subprocess.Popen(args,env={**os.environ,"GOMAXPROCS":"2","GOMEMLIMIT":"256MiB"},stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=handle,stderr=handle)
        handle.close();self.processes.append(proc)
        return proc

    def wait_etcd(self):
        for _ in range(120):
            try:
                conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=.3)
                conn.request('GET','/health');response=conn.getresponse();response.read();conn.close()
                if response.status==200:return
            except OSError:pass
            if self.etcd.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/'etcd.log').read_text())
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real etcd startup timed out')

    def start_api(self):
        self.api=self.spawn(self.api_name,['kube-apiserver','--bind-address=127.0.0.1','--advertise-address=127.0.0.1','--secure-port='+str(self.port),'--etcd-servers=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port),'--tls-cert-file='+str(self.root/'server.crt'),'--tls-private-key-file='+str(self.root/'server.key'),'--client-ca-file='+str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC','--enable-admission-plugins=NodeRestriction','--disable-admission-plugins=ServiceAccount','--anonymous-auth=false','--service-cluster-ip-range=10.240.0.0/24','--service-account-issuer=https://kubernetes.default.svc','--service-account-signing-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--service-account-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--encryption-provider-config='+str(self.encryption_path),'--watch-cache=false','--profiling=false','--v=0'])
        for _ in range(240):
            try:
                code,_=self.request('GET','/readyz')
                if code==200:return
            except (OSError,ssl.SSLError,http.client.HTTPException):pass
            if self.api.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/(self.api_name+'.log')).read_text()[-10000:])
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real kube-apiserver startup timed out')

    def restart_api(self, encryption):
        self.api.terminate();self.api.wait(timeout=10)
        self.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        self.start_api()

    def peer(self, encryption):
        peer=object.__new__(Cluster)
        peer.root=self.root
        peer.processes=[]
        peer.port=free_port();peer.etcd_port=self.etcd_port
        peer.url='https://127.0.0.1:'+str(peer.port)
        peer.api_name='apiserver-peer-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
        peer.encryption_path=self.root/(peer.api_name+'.json')
        peer.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        peer.start_api()
        return peer

    def config(self, identity='learner'):
        result={'server':self.url,'ca':str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'cert':str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),'key':str(self.root/(identity+'.key'))}
        target=self.root/(identity+'-client.json');target.write_text(json.dumps(result))
        return str(target)

    def request(self, method, path, data=None, identity='admin', content_type='application/json'):
        context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(self.root/'ca.crt'))
        context.load_cert_chain(str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),str(self.root/(identity+'.key')))
        conn=http.client.HTTPSConnection('127.0.0.1',self.port,context=context,timeout=5)
        body=json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None
        conn.request(method,path,body=body,headers={'Content-Type':content_type})
        response=conn.getresponse();raw=response.read();code=response.status;conn.close()
        try:return code,json.loads(raw)
        except ValueError:return code,raw.decode(errors='replace')

    def create(self, path, obj):
        code,value=self.request('POST',path,obj)
        assert code==201,(code,value)
        return value

    def namespace(self, name):
        return self.create('/api/v1/namespaces',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Namespace','metadata':{'name':name}})

    def etcd_value(self, key):
        conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=5)
        conn.request('POST','/v3/kv/range',json.dumps({'key':base64.b64encode(key.encode()).decode()}),{'Content-Type':'application/json'})
        response=conn.getresponse();result=json.loads(response.read());conn.close()
        assert response.status==200,result
        return base64.b64decode(result['kvs'][0]['value'])

    def close(self):
        for proc in reversed(self.processes):
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.terminate()
                try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait()
        if hasattr(self,'tmp'):self.tmp.cleanup()

    def __enter__(self):return self
    def __exit__(self,*args):self.close()


if __name__=='__main__':
    started=time.monotonic()
    with Cluster() as cluster:
        print(json.dumps({'ready':cluster.request('GET','/readyz'),'version':cluster.request('GET','/version'),'seconds':time.monotonic()-started}),flush=True)

## 环境与初始材料
固定Go模块及真实私有API；仅编辑task.go和design.json，其他材料不改。

## 操作任务
实现RunVersion：真实old/new两个controller-runtime Manager在同一namespace并存，共用提供的leaderID及Lease配置，仅选主后的控制器写入同名输出，记录writerVersion与真实Lease holder。兼容公共spec.value协议并保留newHint等新可选字段；更新、真实lease交接和回滚old后重读当前API，保持输出UID。这里是两个应用版本的兼容协议验证，SDK均固定，不声称跨SDK二进制升级或实际Pod部署已完成。

## 产物
task.go
design.json语义映射：{"coexist": "old-and-new-native-managers", "writer_control": "same-leader-id-namespace-lease", "protocol": "common-value-preserve-new-optional-fields", "audit": "version-plus-actual-lease-holder", "rollback": "lease-handoff-and-current-api-state"}

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py。真实controller-runtime循环及API对象状态变化，参考/未完成/错解/合法替代/原生提前退出分别验证。

## 能力边界
真实Go控制器/工作队列及私有Kubernetes1.34.1 API/etcd3.6.4；独立CA和临时资源，自有PID RSS768MiB/90s预算，默认身份/PATH/GOPATH/context不变。不安装业务或Operator镜像，不声称Pod运行、生产SLO或完整模块验收。

FIXED={'go.mod': '794de86e82f603624c7eee9ddf413184954552fae5bba113048fdc3188553943', 'go.sum': 'bb543f322090505347c91d07a0080c2b64ec3c8139a8a2762097b4673a6ba055', 'contract.go': '3407d6196ab9a54c21ec735a9b0f425762b31fa406acbd9fe70351a894ec3e3e', 'crd.json': 'f4df76cfa8f743d9b09c04730f312b76422c9bbe0d3e2023f30d5ed7d4cff120'}
REQUIRED_PLAN={'coexist': 'old-and-new-native-managers', 'writer_control': 'same-leader-id-namespace-lease', 'protocol': 'common-value-preserve-new-optional-fields', 'audit': 'version-plus-actual-lease-holder', 'rollback': 'lease-handoff-and-current-api-state'}
GO_MOD_ARGS=[]
NEED_API=True
import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,re,signal,subprocess,sys,time
sys.path.insert(0,'checks')
from bounded_api import BoundedCluster
ROOT=pathlib.Path.cwd()
for name,digest in FIXED.items():
 assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,'fixed material modified: '+name
plan=json.loads((ROOT/'design.json').read_text())
for key,value in REQUIRED_PLAN.items():assert plan.get(key)==value,'design contract: '+key
native=pathlib.Path('/tmp/opsforge-s05-operator-batch002-20261029')
if not (native/'gomodcache/k8s.io/client-go@v0.34.1').is_dir():raise RuntimeError('fixed native client-go module cache missing')
env=dict(os.environ,GOMODCACHE=str(native/'gomodcache'),GOCACHE=str(native/'gocache'),GOPROXY='off',GOTOOLCHAIN='local',GOMAXPROCS='2',GOMEMLIMIT='128MiB',CGO_ENABLED='0')
(ROOT/'native-tmp').mkdir(exist_ok=True);env['TMPDIR']=str(ROOT/'native-tmp')
from bounded_api import Budget
# Compile against the fixed real modules before starting native servers. This
# keeps compiler RSS and API RSS from unnecessarily overlapping; neither budget
# is relaxed. No application source is generated or changed during validation.
with Budget() as compile_budget:
 with (ROOT/'go-compile.log').open('wb') as log:
  compile_proc=subprocess.Popen(['go','test','-mod=readonly',*GO_MOD_ARGS,'-ldflags=-s -w','-c','-o',str(ROOT/'native-tests'),'.'],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env=env,start_new_session=True)
  compile_budget.watch(compile_proc,group=True)
  while compile_proc.poll() is None:compile_budget.check();time.sleep(.03)
  compile_budget.check()
 if compile_proc.returncode:raise RuntimeError('native compilation failed: '+(ROOT/'go-compile.log').read_text()[-3000:])
def execute(budget):
 with (ROOT/'go-native.log').open('wb') as log:
  proc=subprocess.Popen(['go','tool','test2json','-t','-p','opsforge.local/operatorbatch006',str(ROOT/'native-tests'),'-test.count=1','-test.timeout=45s','-test.v=test2json'],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env=env,start_new_session=True)
  budget.watch(proc,group=True)
  while proc.poll() is None:
   budget.check();time.sleep(.03)
  budget.check()
 text=(ROOT/'go-native.log').read_text();print(text)
 if proc.returncode and '--- FAIL:' not in text and 'panic: IMPLEMENT_NATIVE_OPERATION' not in text:raise RuntimeError('native build/tool/checker error: '+text[-3000:])
 assert proc.returncode==0,'native semantic tests failed'
 expected={name for p in ROOT.glob('*_test.go') for name in re.findall(r'^func (Test\w+)\(',p.read_text(),re.M)}
 events=[json.loads(line) for line in text.splitlines() if line.startswith('{')]
 passed={e.get('Test') for e in events if e.get('Action')=='pass' and e.get('Test')}
 assert expected and expected<=passed,'native tests did not all complete; early exit is not success'
if NEED_API:
 with BoundedCluster() as cluster:
  env['OPSF_PRIVATE_CONFIG']=cluster.config('admin');env['OPSF_ETCD_PORT']=str(cluster.etcd_port);execute(cluster.budget)
else:
 with Budget() as budget:execute(budget)
print('NATIVE_OPERATOR_B002_COMPLETE')

"""Private native API fixture: real etcd and kube-apiserver, no kubeconfig changes."""
import base64
import contextlib
import http.client
import json
import os
import pathlib
import secrets
import socket
import ssl
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time


def free_port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


class Cluster:
    def __init__(self, encryption=None):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-s05-operator-b006-api-')
        self.root = pathlib.Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.processes = []
        self.api_name = 'apiserver'
        self.encryption_path = self.root/'encryption.json'
        self.port, self.etcd_port, self.peer_port = free_port(), free_port(), free_port()
        self.url = 'https://127.0.0.1:' + str(self.port)
        self.run('openssl', 'ecparam', '-name', 'prime256v1', '-genkey', '-noout', '-out', str(self.root/'ca.key'))
        self.run('openssl', 'req', '-x509', '-new', '-key', str(self.root/'ca.key'), '-out', str(self.root/'ca.crt'), '-days', '1', '-subj', '/CN=opsforge-pilot-private-ca')
        self.identity('server', 'localhost', extensions='subjectAltName=IP:127.0.0.1\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\n')
        self.identity('admin', 'opsforge-pilot-admin', 'system:masters')
        self.identity('learner', 'opsforge-pilot-user')
        (self.root/'encryption.json').write_text(json.dumps(encryption or {'apiVersion':'apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1','kind':'EncryptionConfiguration','resources':[{'resources':['secrets'],'providers':[{'identity':{}}]}]}))
        self.etcd = self.spawn('etcd', ['etcd', '--name=pilot', '--data-dir='+str(self.root/'data'), '--listen-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--advertise-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--listen-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-advertise-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-cluster=pilot=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--quota-backend-bytes=67108864', '--logger=zap', '--log-level=error'])
        self.wait_etcd()
        self.start_api()

    def run(self, *args):
        return subprocess.run(args, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)

    def identity(self, name, cn, org=None, extensions='extendedKeyUsage=clientAuth\n'):
        key, csr, crt = [self.root/(name+suffix) for suffix in ('.key','.csr','.crt')]
        self.run('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',str(key))
        self.run('openssl','req','-new','-key',str(key),'-out',str(csr),'-subj','/CN='+cn+('/O='+org if org else ''))
        ext=self.root/(name+'.ext');ext.write_text(extensions)
        self.run('openssl','x509','-req','-in',str(csr),'-CA',str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'-CAkey',str(self.root/'ca.key'),'-CAcreateserial','-out',str(crt),'-days','1','-extfile',str(ext))
        return name

    def spawn(self, name, args):
        handle=(self.root/(name+'.log')).open('ab')
        proc=subprocess.Popen(args,env={**os.environ,"GOMAXPROCS":"2","GOMEMLIMIT":"256MiB"},stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=handle,stderr=handle)
        handle.close();self.processes.append(proc)
        return proc

    def wait_etcd(self):
        for _ in range(120):
            try:
                conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=.3)
                conn.request('GET','/health');response=conn.getresponse();response.read();conn.close()
                if response.status==200:return
            except OSError:pass
            if self.etcd.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/'etcd.log').read_text())
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real etcd startup timed out')

    def start_api(self):
        self.api=self.spawn(self.api_name,['kube-apiserver','--bind-address=127.0.0.1','--advertise-address=127.0.0.1','--secure-port='+str(self.port),'--etcd-servers=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port),'--tls-cert-file='+str(self.root/'server.crt'),'--tls-private-key-file='+str(self.root/'server.key'),'--client-ca-file='+str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC','--enable-admission-plugins=NodeRestriction','--disable-admission-plugins=ServiceAccount','--anonymous-auth=false','--service-cluster-ip-range=10.240.0.0/24','--service-account-issuer=https://kubernetes.default.svc','--service-account-signing-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--service-account-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--encryption-provider-config='+str(self.encryption_path),'--watch-cache=false','--profiling=false','--v=0'])
        for _ in range(240):
            try:
                code,_=self.request('GET','/readyz')
                if code==200:return
            except (OSError,ssl.SSLError,http.client.HTTPException):pass
            if self.api.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/(self.api_name+'.log')).read_text()[-10000:])
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real kube-apiserver startup timed out')

    def restart_api(self, encryption):
        self.api.terminate();self.api.wait(timeout=10)
        self.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        self.start_api()

    def peer(self, encryption):
        peer=object.__new__(Cluster)
        peer.root=self.root
        peer.processes=[]
        peer.port=free_port();peer.etcd_port=self.etcd_port
        peer.url='https://127.0.0.1:'+str(peer.port)
        peer.api_name='apiserver-peer-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
        peer.encryption_path=self.root/(peer.api_name+'.json')
        peer.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        peer.start_api()
        return peer

    def config(self, identity='learner'):
        result={'server':self.url,'ca':str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'cert':str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),'key':str(self.root/(identity+'.key'))}
        target=self.root/(identity+'-client.json');target.write_text(json.dumps(result))
        return str(target)

    def request(self, method, path, data=None, identity='admin', content_type='application/json'):
        context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(self.root/'ca.crt'))
        context.load_cert_chain(str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),str(self.root/(identity+'.key')))
        conn=http.client.HTTPSConnection('127.0.0.1',self.port,context=context,timeout=5)
        body=json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None
        conn.request(method,path,body=body,headers={'Content-Type':content_type})
        response=conn.getresponse();raw=response.read();code=response.status;conn.close()
        try:return code,json.loads(raw)
        except ValueError:return code,raw.decode(errors='replace')

    def create(self, path, obj):
        code,value=self.request('POST',path,obj)
        assert code==201,(code,value)
        return value

    def namespace(self, name):
        return self.create('/api/v1/namespaces',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Namespace','metadata':{'name':name}})

    def etcd_value(self, key):
        conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=5)
        conn.request('POST','/v3/kv/range',json.dumps({'key':base64.b64encode(key.encode()).decode()}),{'Content-Type':'application/json'})
        response=conn.getresponse();result=json.loads(response.read());conn.close()
        assert response.status==200,result
        return base64.b64decode(result['kvs'][0]['value'])

    def close(self):
        for proc in reversed(self.processes):
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.terminate()
                try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait()
        if hasattr(self,'tmp'):self.tmp.cleanup()

    def __enter__(self):return self
    def __exit__(self,*args):self.close()


if __name__=='__main__':
    started=time.monotonic()
    with Cluster() as cluster:
        print(json.dumps({'ready':cluster.request('GET','/readyz'),'version':cluster.request('GET','/version'),'seconds':time.monotonic()-started}),flush=True)

title: 外部异步任务完成时CR已被再次修改，如何交付陈旧结果隔离与任务接管验收？
body:
## 环境与初始材料
固定Go模块及真实私有API；仅编辑task.go和design.json，其他材料不改。

## 操作任务
协调实际MySQL EVENT长异步工作：操作ID绑定真实CR UID/generation/spec摘要，SQL operations记录重启交接依据。摘要是有效spec的确定性摘要，算法/编码可选；不同value应不同、同spec回滚或新UID时摘要应相同，但新generation/UID必须仍是新操作ID，不能复用旧结果。首次scheduler关闭的pending旧事件须实际撤销；已开始事件即使DROP定义仍可能稍后提交旧SQL结果，必须留审计并不得确认新代数。新Manager重读SQL接管，相同意图重跑不重复提交，同名新UID不继承旧操作。结果只在当前ID真实完成且值匹配时Ready。此原题未指定云作业平台，使用真实MySQL EVENT/SQL持久副作用，不伪造云job接口，不声称MySQL提供跨Kubernetes事务。

## 产物
task.go
design.json语义映射：{"operation_identity": "uid-generation-spec-digest", "cancelable": "native-pending-event-definition-drop", "noncancelable": "begun-sql-may-commit-after-drop", "late_result": "old-operation-audit-not-new-ready", "restart": "native-sql-ledger-takeover", "same_name_new_uid": "new-operation-key"}

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py。真实controller-runtime循环及API对象状态变化，参考/未完成/错解/合法替代/原生提前退出分别验证。

## 能力边界
真实Go控制器/工作队列及私有Kubernetes1.34.1 API/etcd3.6.4；独立CA和临时资源，自有PID RSS768MiB/90s预算，默认身份/PATH/GOPATH/context不变。不安装业务或Operator镜像，不声称Pod运行、生产SLO或完整模块验收。
source: OpsForge 高阶补充编审 2026-10-22
review_note: 作者编审；独立复核待作者外代理，跨会话及统一登记未完成。
rubric: 给出框架层和外部协议层各自责任
定义状态不变量与故障注入反例
证明陈旧或不完整证据不能触发危险动作

exercise.environment: 真实Go控制器/工作队列及私有Kubernetes1.34.1 API/etcd3.6.4；独立CA和临时资源，自有PID RSS768MiB/90s预算，默认身份/PATH/GOPATH/context不变。不安装业务或Operator镜像，不声称Pod运行、生产SLO或完整模块验收。
exercise.operation: 协调实际MySQL EVENT长异步工作：操作ID绑定真实CR UID/generation/spec摘要，SQL operations记录重启交接依据。摘要是有效spec的确定性摘要，算法/编码可选；不同value应不同、同spec回滚或新UID时摘要应相同，但新generation/UID必须仍是新操作ID，不能复用旧结果。首次scheduler关闭的pending旧事件须实际撤销；已开始事件即使DROP定义仍可能稍后提交旧SQL结果，必须留审计并不得确认新代数。新Manager重读SQL接管，相同意图重跑不重复提交，同名新UID不继承旧操作。结果只在当前ID真实完成且值匹配时Ready。此原题未指定云作业平台，使用真实MySQL EVENT/SQL持久副作用，不伪造云job接口，不声称MySQL提供跨Kubernetes事务。

"""Private native API fixture: real etcd and kube-apiserver, no kubeconfig changes."""
import base64
import contextlib
import http.client
import json
import os
import pathlib
import secrets
import socket
import ssl
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time


def free_port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


class Cluster:
    def __init__(self, encryption=None):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-s05-operator-b006-api-')
        self.root = pathlib.Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.processes = []
        self.api_name = 'apiserver'
        self.encryption_path = self.root/'encryption.json'
        self.port, self.etcd_port, self.peer_port = free_port(), free_port(), free_port()
        self.url = 'https://127.0.0.1:' + str(self.port)
        self.run('openssl', 'ecparam', '-name', 'prime256v1', '-genkey', '-noout', '-out', str(self.root/'ca.key'))
        self.run('openssl', 'req', '-x509', '-new', '-key', str(self.root/'ca.key'), '-out', str(self.root/'ca.crt'), '-days', '1', '-subj', '/CN=opsforge-pilot-private-ca')
        self.identity('server', 'localhost', extensions='subjectAltName=IP:127.0.0.1\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\n')
        self.identity('admin', 'opsforge-pilot-admin', 'system:masters')
        self.identity('learner', 'opsforge-pilot-user')
        (self.root/'encryption.json').write_text(json.dumps(encryption or {'apiVersion':'apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1','kind':'EncryptionConfiguration','resources':[{'resources':['secrets'],'providers':[{'identity':{}}]}]}))
        self.etcd = self.spawn('etcd', ['etcd', '--name=pilot', '--data-dir='+str(self.root/'data'), '--listen-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--advertise-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--listen-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-advertise-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-cluster=pilot=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--quota-backend-bytes=67108864', '--logger=zap', '--log-level=error'])
        self.wait_etcd()
        self.start_api()

    def run(self, *args):
        return subprocess.run(args, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)

    def identity(self, name, cn, org=None, extensions='extendedKeyUsage=clientAuth\n'):
        key, csr, crt = [self.root/(name+suffix) for suffix in ('.key','.csr','.crt')]
        self.run('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',str(key))
        self.run('openssl','req','-new','-key',str(key),'-out',str(csr),'-subj','/CN='+cn+('/O='+org if org else ''))
        ext=self.root/(name+'.ext');ext.write_text(extensions)
        self.run('openssl','x509','-req','-in',str(csr),'-CA',str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'-CAkey',str(self.root/'ca.key'),'-CAcreateserial','-out',str(crt),'-days','1','-extfile',str(ext))
        return name

    def spawn(self, name, args):
        handle=(self.root/(name+'.log')).open('ab')
        proc=subprocess.Popen(args,env={**os.environ,"GOMAXPROCS":"2","GOMEMLIMIT":"256MiB"},stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=handle,stderr=handle)
        handle.close();self.processes.append(proc)
        return proc

    def wait_etcd(self):
        for _ in range(120):
            try:
                conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=.3)
                conn.request('GET','/health');response=conn.getresponse();response.read();conn.close()
                if response.status==200:return
            except OSError:pass
            if self.etcd.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/'etcd.log').read_text())
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real etcd startup timed out')

    def start_api(self):
        self.api=self.spawn(self.api_name,['kube-apiserver','--bind-address=127.0.0.1','--advertise-address=127.0.0.1','--secure-port='+str(self.port),'--etcd-servers=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port),'--tls-cert-file='+str(self.root/'server.crt'),'--tls-private-key-file='+str(self.root/'server.key'),'--client-ca-file='+str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC','--enable-admission-plugins=NodeRestriction','--disable-admission-plugins=ServiceAccount','--anonymous-auth=false','--service-cluster-ip-range=10.240.0.0/24','--service-account-issuer=https://kubernetes.default.svc','--service-account-signing-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--service-account-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--encryption-provider-config='+str(self.encryption_path),'--watch-cache=false','--profiling=false','--v=0'])
        for _ in range(240):
            try:
                code,_=self.request('GET','/readyz')
                if code==200:return
            except (OSError,ssl.SSLError,http.client.HTTPException):pass
            if self.api.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/(self.api_name+'.log')).read_text()[-10000:])
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real kube-apiserver startup timed out')

    def restart_api(self, encryption):
        self.api.terminate();self.api.wait(timeout=10)
        self.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        self.start_api()

    def peer(self, encryption):
        peer=object.__new__(Cluster)
        peer.root=self.root
        peer.processes=[]
        peer.port=free_port();peer.etcd_port=self.etcd_port
        peer.url='https://127.0.0.1:'+str(peer.port)
        peer.api_name='apiserver-peer-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
        peer.encryption_path=self.root/(peer.api_name+'.json')
        peer.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        peer.start_api()
        return peer

    def config(self, identity='learner'):
        result={'server':self.url,'ca':str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'cert':str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),'key':str(self.root/(identity+'.key'))}
        target=self.root/(identity+'-client.json');target.write_text(json.dumps(result))
        return str(target)

    def request(self, method, path, data=None, identity='admin', content_type='application/json'):
        context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(self.root/'ca.crt'))
        context.load_cert_chain(str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),str(self.root/(identity+'.key')))
        conn=http.client.HTTPSConnection('127.0.0.1',self.port,context=context,timeout=5)
        body=json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None
        conn.request(method,path,body=body,headers={'Content-Type':content_type})
        response=conn.getresponse();raw=response.read();code=response.status;conn.close()
        try:return code,json.loads(raw)
        except ValueError:return code,raw.decode(errors='replace')

    def create(self, path, obj):
        code,value=self.request('POST',path,obj)
        assert code==201,(code,value)
        return value

    def namespace(self, name):
        return self.create('/api/v1/namespaces',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Namespace','metadata':{'name':name}})

    def etcd_value(self, key):
        conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=5)
        conn.request('POST','/v3/kv/range',json.dumps({'key':base64.b64encode(key.encode()).decode()}),{'Content-Type':'application/json'})
        response=conn.getresponse();result=json.loads(response.read());conn.close()
        assert response.status==200,result
        return base64.b64decode(result['kvs'][0]['value'])

    def close(self):
        for proc in reversed(self.processes):
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.terminate()
                try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait()
        if hasattr(self,'tmp'):self.tmp.cleanup()

    def __enter__(self):return self
    def __exit__(self,*args):self.close()


if __name__=='__main__':
    started=time.monotonic()
    with Cluster() as cluster:
        print(json.dumps({'ready':cluster.request('GET','/readyz'),'version':cluster.request('GET','/version'),'seconds':time.monotonic()-started}),flush=True)

## 环境与初始材料
固定Go模块及真实私有API；仅编辑task.go和design.json，其他材料不改。

## 操作任务
实现真实MySQL EVENT的可重入非终态：Pending以实际事件定义/未启动为证，Running以started有行/results无行为证，WaitingDependency以真实event_scheduler关闭为证，Unknown以真实表锁造成客户端readTimeout为证；超时期间SQL可能已执行，恢复或新Manager须按同一operationID从SQL结果接管。删除已运行工作时Cleaning保持CR/finalizer直到真实结果和事件定义清理均可确认，随后记录Cleaned才移除本题finalizer；原生删除可能提升观测generation，清理沿用SQL中UID校验的原操作身份，不能凭删除代数重算一个未提交的工作。各状态包含当前UID、观测generation、操作摘要和明确reason，只有当前结果可确认才Ready，不把等待/未知/清理当失败或成功。

## 产物
task.go
design.json语义映射：{"nonterminal": ["Pending", "Running", "WaitingDependency", "Unknown", "Cleaning"], "evidence": "native-event-metadata-start-result-and-real-read-timeout", "timeout": "does-not-prove-nonexecution", "identity": "stable-current-uid-generation-spec", "terminal": "native-current-result-or-confirmed-cleanup"}

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py。真实controller-runtime循环及API对象状态变化，参考/未完成/错解/合法替代/原生提前退出分别验证。

## 能力边界
真实Go控制器/工作队列及私有Kubernetes1.34.1 API/etcd3.6.4；独立CA和临时资源，自有PID RSS768MiB/90s预算，默认身份/PATH/GOPATH/context不变。不安装业务或Operator镜像，不声称Pod运行、生产SLO或完整模块验收。

REQUIRED_PLAN={'nonterminal': ['Pending', 'Running', 'WaitingDependency', 'Unknown', 'Cleaning'], 'evidence': 'native-event-metadata-start-result-and-real-read-timeout', 'timeout': 'does-not-prove-nonexecution', 'identity': 'stable-current-uid-generation-spec', 'terminal': 'native-current-result-or-confirmed-cleanup'}
GO_MOD_ARGS=[]
NEED_API=True
import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,re,signal,subprocess,sys,time
sys.path.insert(0,'checks')
from bounded_api import BoundedCluster
ROOT=pathlib.Path.cwd()
for name,digest in FIXED.items():
 assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,'fixed material modified: '+name
plan=json.loads((ROOT/'design.json').read_text())
for key,value in REQUIRED_PLAN.items():assert plan.get(key)==value,'design contract: '+key
native=pathlib.Path('/tmp/opsforge-s05-operator-batch002-20261029')
if not (native/'gomodcache/k8s.io/client-go@v0.34.1').is_dir():raise RuntimeError('fixed native client-go module cache missing')
env=dict(os.environ,GOMODCACHE=str(native/'gomodcache'),GOCACHE=str(native/'gocache'),GOPROXY='off',GOTOOLCHAIN='local',GOMAXPROCS='2',GOMEMLIMIT='128MiB',CGO_ENABLED='0')
(ROOT/'native-tmp').mkdir(exist_ok=True);env['TMPDIR']=str(ROOT/'native-tmp')
from bounded_api import Budget
# Compile against the fixed real modules before starting native servers. This
# keeps compiler RSS and API RSS from unnecessarily overlapping; neither budget
# is relaxed. No application source is generated or changed during validation.
with Budget() as compile_budget:
 with (ROOT/'go-compile.log').open('wb') as log:
  compile_proc=subprocess.Popen(['go','test','-mod=readonly',*GO_MOD_ARGS,'-ldflags=-s -w','-c','-o',str(ROOT/'native-tests'),'.'],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env=env,start_new_session=True)
  compile_budget.watch(compile_proc,group=True)
  while compile_proc.poll() is None:compile_budget.check();time.sleep(.03)
  compile_budget.check()
 if compile_proc.returncode:raise RuntimeError('native compilation failed: '+(ROOT/'go-compile.log').read_text()[-3000:])
def execute(budget):
 with (ROOT/'go-native.log').open('wb') as log:
  proc=subprocess.Popen(['go','tool','test2json','-t','-p','opsforge.local/operatorbatch006',str(ROOT/'native-tests'),'-test.count=1','-test.timeout=45s','-test.v=test2json'],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env=env,start_new_session=True)
  budget.watch(proc,group=True)
  while proc.poll() is None:
   budget.check();time.sleep(.03)
  budget.check()
 text=(ROOT/'go-native.log').read_text();print(text)
 if proc.returncode and '--- FAIL:' not in text and 'panic: IMPLEMENT_NATIVE_OPERATION' not in text:raise RuntimeError('native build/tool/checker error: '+text[-3000:])
 assert proc.returncode==0,'native semantic tests failed'
 expected={name for p in ROOT.glob('*_test.go') for name in re.findall(r'^func (Test\w+)\(',p.read_text(),re.M)}
 events=[json.loads(line) for line in text.splitlines() if line.startswith('{')]
 passed={e.get('Test') for e in events if e.get('Action')=='pass' and e.get('Test')}
 assert expected and expected<=passed,'native tests did not all complete; early exit is not success'
if NEED_API:
 with BoundedCluster() as cluster:
  from native_mysql import NativeMySQL
  with NativeMySQL(cluster.budget) as db:
   env['OPSF_MYSQL_SOCKET']=str(db.socket);env['OPSF_PRIVATE_CONFIG']=cluster.config('admin');env['OPSF_ETCD_PORT']=str(cluster.etcd_port);execute(cluster.budget)
else:
 with Budget() as budget:execute(budget)
print('NATIVE_OPERATOR_B002_COMPLETE')
