"""Private native API fixture: real etcd and kube-apiserver, no kubeconfig changes."""
import base64
import contextlib
import http.client
import json
import os
import pathlib
import secrets
import socket
import ssl
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time


def free_port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


class Cluster:
    def __init__(self, encryption=None):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-s05-operator-b006-api-')
        self.root = pathlib.Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.processes = []
        self.api_name = 'apiserver'
        self.encryption_path = self.root/'encryption.json'
        self.port, self.etcd_port, self.peer_port = free_port(), free_port(), free_port()
        self.url = 'https://127.0.0.1:' + str(self.port)
        self.run('openssl', 'ecparam', '-name', 'prime256v1', '-genkey', '-noout', '-out', str(self.root/'ca.key'))
        self.run('openssl', 'req', '-x509', '-new', '-key', str(self.root/'ca.key'), '-out', str(self.root/'ca.crt'), '-days', '1', '-subj', '/CN=opsforge-pilot-private-ca')
        self.identity('server', 'localhost', extensions='subjectAltName=IP:127.0.0.1\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\n')
        self.identity('admin', 'opsforge-pilot-admin', 'system:masters')
        self.identity('learner', 'opsforge-pilot-user')
        (self.root/'encryption.json').write_text(json.dumps(encryption or {'apiVersion':'apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1','kind':'EncryptionConfiguration','resources':[{'resources':['secrets'],'providers':[{'identity':{}}]}]}))
        self.etcd = self.spawn('etcd', ['etcd', '--name=pilot', '--data-dir='+str(self.root/'data'), '--listen-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--advertise-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--listen-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-advertise-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-cluster=pilot=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--quota-backend-bytes=67108864', '--logger=zap', '--log-level=error'])
        self.wait_etcd()
        self.start_api()

    def run(self, *args):
        return subprocess.run(args, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)

    def identity(self, name, cn, org=None, extensions='extendedKeyUsage=clientAuth\n'):
        key, csr, crt = [self.root/(name+suffix) for suffix in ('.key','.csr','.crt')]
        self.run('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',str(key))
        self.run('openssl','req','-new','-key',str(key),'-out',str(csr),'-subj','/CN='+cn+('/O='+org if org else ''))
        ext=self.root/(name+'.ext');ext.write_text(extensions)
        self.run('openssl','x509','-req','-in',str(csr),'-CA',str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'-CAkey',str(self.root/'ca.key'),'-CAcreateserial','-out',str(crt),'-days','1','-extfile',str(ext))
        return name

    def spawn(self, name, args):
        handle=(self.root/(name+'.log')).open('ab')
        proc=subprocess.Popen(args,env={**os.environ,"GOMAXPROCS":"2","GOMEMLIMIT":"256MiB"},stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=handle,stderr=handle)
        handle.close();self.processes.append(proc)
        return proc

    def wait_etcd(self):
        for _ in range(120):
            try:
                conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=.3)
                conn.request('GET','/health');response=conn.getresponse();response.read();conn.close()
                if response.status==200:return
            except OSError:pass
            if self.etcd.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/'etcd.log').read_text())
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real etcd startup timed out')

    def start_api(self):
        self.api=self.spawn(self.api_name,['kube-apiserver','--bind-address=127.0.0.1','--advertise-address=127.0.0.1','--secure-port='+str(self.port),'--etcd-servers=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port),'--tls-cert-file='+str(self.root/'server.crt'),'--tls-private-key-file='+str(self.root/'server.key'),'--client-ca-file='+str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC','--enable-admission-plugins=NodeRestriction','--disable-admission-plugins=ServiceAccount','--anonymous-auth=false','--service-cluster-ip-range=10.240.0.0/24','--service-account-issuer=https://kubernetes.default.svc','--service-account-signing-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--service-account-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--encryption-provider-config='+str(self.encryption_path),'--watch-cache=false','--profiling=false','--v=0'])
        for _ in range(240):
            try:
                code,_=self.request('GET','/readyz')
                if code==200:return
            except (OSError,ssl.SSLError,http.client.HTTPException):pass
            if self.api.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/(self.api_name+'.log')).read_text()[-10000:])
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real kube-apiserver startup timed out')

    def restart_api(self, encryption):
        self.api.terminate();self.api.wait(timeout=10)
        self.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        self.start_api()

    def peer(self, encryption):
        peer=object.__new__(Cluster)
        peer.root=self.root
        peer.processes=[]
        peer.port=free_port();peer.etcd_port=self.etcd_port
        peer.url='https://127.0.0.1:'+str(peer.port)
        peer.api_name='apiserver-peer-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
        peer.encryption_path=self.root/(peer.api_name+'.json')
        peer.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        peer.start_api()
        return peer

    def config(self, identity='learner'):
        result={'server':self.url,'ca':str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'cert':str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),'key':str(self.root/(identity+'.key'))}
        target=self.root/(identity+'-client.json');target.write_text(json.dumps(result))
        return str(target)

    def request(self, method, path, data=None, identity='admin', content_type='application/json'):
        context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(self.root/'ca.crt'))
        context.load_cert_chain(str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),str(self.root/(identity+'.key')))
        conn=http.client.HTTPSConnection('127.0.0.1',self.port,context=context,timeout=5)
        body=json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None
        conn.request(method,path,body=body,headers={'Content-Type':content_type})
        response=conn.getresponse();raw=response.read();code=response.status;conn.close()
        try:return code,json.loads(raw)
        except ValueError:return code,raw.decode(errors='replace')

    def create(self, path, obj):
        code,value=self.request('POST',path,obj)
        assert code==201,(code,value)
        return value

    def namespace(self, name):
        return self.create('/api/v1/namespaces',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Namespace','metadata':{'name':name}})

    def etcd_value(self, key):
        conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=5)
        conn.request('POST','/v3/kv/range',json.dumps({'key':base64.b64encode(key.encode()).decode()}),{'Content-Type':'application/json'})
        response=conn.getresponse();result=json.loads(response.read());conn.close()
        assert response.status==200,result
        return base64.b64decode(result['kvs'][0]['value'])

    def close(self):
        for proc in reversed(self.processes):
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.terminate()
                try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait()
        if hasattr(self,'tmp'):self.tmp.cleanup()

    def __enter__(self):return self
    def __exit__(self,*args):self.close()


if __name__=='__main__':
    started=time.monotonic()
    with Cluster() as cluster:
        print(json.dumps({'ready':cluster.request('GET','/readyz'),'version':cluster.request('GET','/version'),'seconds':time.monotonic()-started}),flush=True)

## 环境与初始材料
固定Go模块及真实私有API；仅编辑task.go和design.json，其他材料不改。

## 操作任务
实现数据库Retain/Delete边界。未写策略默认Retain，真实数据库保留且SQL审计明确retained_by责任主体后才解除本finalizer；未知策略不删除。Delete需关闭protect、审批UID匹配当前CR、外部数据库owner_uid匹配；要求备份时必须有当前UID的Ready备份记录且实际文件SHA匹配。沿用本实验既有machine-readable接口status.reason：AwaitApproval=审批UID缺少/不符，BackupRequired=没有当前UID及数据库的Ready备份，BackupInvalid=现有备份记录/实际文件核验失败，Protected=保护未关闭，UnknownPolicy=不支持的策略，OwnershipConflict=外部owner UID不符。只规定这些实际消费的门禁原因码，不额外要求phase/observedGeneration/owner字段或特定辅助函数/SQL写法。备份由现有外部备份角色提供，可信检查真实mysqldump并通过原生mysql客户端恢复验证数据，再依次验证错误归属与损坏文件拒绝。全部条件满足才实际DROP目标库并记录含备份SHA的审计，其他数据库不动。本题重点策略与已有备份门禁，自动备份/权限丢失/超时接管链另题验证；不造自定义云API。

## 产物
task.go
design.json语义映射：{"default": "Retain-with-responsibility", "delete_gates": ["owner-uid", "protection-off", "approval-current-uid", "backup-policy-and-file-hash"], "backup_evidence": "native-mysqldump-and-real-restore", "unknown_policy": "hold-no-irreversible-action", "audit": "durable-owner-and-backup-link"}

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py。真实controller-runtime循环及API对象状态变化，参考/未完成/错解/合法替代/原生提前退出分别验证。

## 能力边界
真实Go控制器/工作队列及私有Kubernetes1.34.1 API/etcd3.6.4；独立CA和临时资源，自有PID RSS768MiB/90s预算，默认身份/PATH/GOPATH/context不变。不安装业务或Operator镜像，不声称Pod运行、生产SLO或完整模块验收。

FIXED={'go.mod': '794de86e82f603624c7eee9ddf413184954552fae5bba113048fdc3188553943', 'go.sum': 'bb543f322090505347c91d07a0080c2b64ec3c8139a8a2762097b4673a6ba055', 'contract.go': 'bef3210ae1567b5e2e1898b7e3ab1bf7ce62e6e53d81aa94c26518db447f6e7d', 'crd.json': '326305646cd1697c2912adc3f06209b7d97478175f5a0a93ec3f8112f6ff6911', 'policy_helpers_test.go': 'a28d4d9a8acfd47274310807d5394960386762704e038aec9809afc270164b37'}
REQUIRED_PLAN={'default': 'Retain-with-responsibility', 'delete_gates': ['owner-uid', 'protection-off', 'approval-current-uid', 'backup-policy-and-file-hash'], 'backup_evidence': 'native-mysqldump-and-real-restore', 'unknown_policy': 'hold-no-irreversible-action', 'audit': 'durable-owner-and-backup-link'}
GO_MOD_ARGS=[]
NEED_API=True
import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,re,signal,subprocess,sys,time
sys.path.insert(0,'checks')
from bounded_api import BoundedCluster
ROOT=pathlib.Path.cwd()
for name,digest in FIXED.items():
 assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,'fixed material modified: '+name
plan=json.loads((ROOT/'design.json').read_text())
for key,value in REQUIRED_PLAN.items():assert plan.get(key)==value,'design contract: '+key
native=pathlib.Path('/tmp/opsforge-s05-operator-batch002-20261029')
if not (native/'gomodcache/k8s.io/client-go@v0.34.1').is_dir():raise RuntimeError('fixed native client-go module cache missing')
env=dict(os.environ,GOMODCACHE=str(native/'gomodcache'),GOCACHE=str(native/'gocache'),GOPROXY='off',GOTOOLCHAIN='local',GOMAXPROCS='2',GOMEMLIMIT='128MiB',CGO_ENABLED='0')
(ROOT/'native-tmp').mkdir(exist_ok=True);env['TMPDIR']=str(ROOT/'native-tmp')
from bounded_api import Budget
# Compile against the fixed real modules before starting native servers. This
# keeps compiler RSS and API RSS from unnecessarily overlapping; neither budget
# is relaxed. No application source is generated or changed during validation.
with Budget() as compile_budget:
 with (ROOT/'go-compile.log').open('wb') as log:
  compile_proc=subprocess.Popen(['go','test','-mod=readonly',*GO_MOD_ARGS,'-ldflags=-s -w','-c','-o',str(ROOT/'native-tests'),'.'],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env=env,start_new_session=True)
  compile_budget.watch(compile_proc,group=True)
  while compile_proc.poll() is None:compile_budget.check();time.sleep(.03)
  compile_budget.check()
 if compile_proc.returncode:raise RuntimeError('native compilation failed: '+(ROOT/'go-compile.log').read_text()[-3000:])
def execute(budget):
 with (ROOT/'go-native.log').open('wb') as log:
  proc=subprocess.Popen(['go','tool','test2json','-t','-p','opsforge.local/operatorbatch006',str(ROOT/'native-tests'),'-test.count=1','-test.timeout=45s','-test.v=test2json'],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env=env,start_new_session=True)
  budget.watch(proc,group=True)
  while proc.poll() is None:
   budget.check();time.sleep(.03)
  budget.check()
 text=(ROOT/'go-native.log').read_text();print(text)
 if proc.returncode and '--- FAIL:' not in text and 'panic: IMPLEMENT_NATIVE_OPERATION' not in text:raise RuntimeError('native build/tool/checker error: '+text[-3000:])
 assert proc.returncode==0,'native semantic tests failed'
 expected={name for p in ROOT.glob('*_test.go') for name in re.findall(r'^func (Test\w+)\(',p.read_text(),re.M)}
 events=[json.loads(line) for line in text.splitlines() if line.startswith('{')]
 passed={e.get('Test') for e in events if e.get('Action')=='pass' and e.get('Test')}
 assert expected and expected<=passed,'native tests did not all complete; early exit is not success'
if NEED_API:
 with BoundedCluster() as cluster:
  from native_mysql import NativeMySQL
  with NativeMySQL(cluster.budget) as db:
   env['OPSF_MYSQL_SOCKET']=str(db.socket);env['OPSF_PRIVATE_CONFIG']=cluster.config('admin');env['OPSF_ETCD_PORT']=str(cluster.etcd_port);execute(cluster.budget)
else:
 with Budget() as budget:execute(budget)
print('NATIVE_OPERATOR_B002_COMPLETE')

    def __init__(self, encryption=None):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-s05-operator-b006-api-')
        self.root = pathlib.Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.processes = []
        self.api_name = 'apiserver'
        self.encryption_path = self.root/'encryption.json'
        self.port, self.etcd_port, self.peer_port = free_port(), free_port(), free_port()
        self.url = 'https://127.0.0.1:' + str(self.port)
        self.run('openssl', 'ecparam', '-name', 'prime256v1', '-genkey', '-noout', '-out', str(self.root/'ca.key'))
        self.run('openssl', 'req', '-x509', '-new', '-key', str(self.root/'ca.key'), '-out', str(self.root/'ca.crt'), '-days', '1', '-subj', '/CN=opsforge-pilot-private-ca')
        self.identity('server', 'localhost', extensions='subjectAltName=IP:127.0.0.1\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\n')
        self.identity('admin', 'opsforge-pilot-admin', 'system:masters')
        self.identity('learner', 'opsforge-pilot-user')
        (self.root/'encryption.json').write_text(json.dumps(encryption or {'apiVersion':'apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1','kind':'EncryptionConfiguration','resources':[{'resources':['secrets'],'providers':[{'identity':{}}]}]}))
        self.etcd = self.spawn('etcd', ['etcd', '--name=pilot', '--data-dir='+str(self.root/'data'), '--listen-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--advertise-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--listen-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-advertise-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-cluster=pilot=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--quota-backend-bytes=67108864', '--logger=zap', '--log-level=error'])
        self.wait_etcd()
        self.start_api()

    def run(self, *args):
        return subprocess.run(args, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)

    def identity(self, name, cn, org=None, extensions='extendedKeyUsage=clientAuth\n'):
        key, csr, crt = [self.root/(name+suffix) for suffix in ('.key','.csr','.crt')]
        self.run('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',str(key))
        self.run('openssl','req','-new','-key',str(key),'-out',str(csr),'-subj','/CN='+cn+('/O='+org if org else ''))
        ext=self.root/(name+'.ext');ext.write_text(extensions)
        self.run('openssl','x509','-req','-in',str(csr),'-CA',str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'-CAkey',str(self.root/'ca.key'),'-CAcreateserial','-out',str(crt),'-days','1','-extfile',str(ext))
        return name

    def spawn(self, name, args):
        handle=(self.root/(name+'.log')).open('ab')
        proc=subprocess.Popen(args,env={**os.environ,"GOMAXPROCS":"2","GOMEMLIMIT":"256MiB"},stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=handle,stderr=handle)
        handle.close();self.processes.append(proc)
        return proc

    def wait_etcd(self):
        for _ in range(120):
            try:
                conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=.3)
                conn.request('GET','/health');response=conn.getresponse();response.read();conn.close()
                if response.status==200:return
            except OSError:pass
            if self.etcd.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/'etcd.log').read_text())
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real etcd startup timed out')

    def start_api(self):
        self.api=self.spawn(self.api_name,['kube-apiserver','--bind-address=127.0.0.1','--advertise-address=127.0.0.1','--secure-port='+str(self.port),'--etcd-servers=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port),'--tls-cert-file='+str(self.root/'server.crt'),'--tls-private-key-file='+str(self.root/'server.key'),'--client-ca-file='+str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC','--enable-admission-plugins=NodeRestriction','--disable-admission-plugins=ServiceAccount','--anonymous-auth=false','--service-cluster-ip-range=10.240.0.0/24','--service-account-issuer=https://kubernetes.default.svc','--service-account-signing-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--service-account-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--encryption-provider-config='+str(self.encryption_path),'--watch-cache=false','--profiling=false','--v=0'])
        for _ in range(240):
            try:
                code,_=self.request('GET','/readyz')
                if code==200:return
            except (OSError,ssl.SSLError,http.client.HTTPException):pass
            if self.api.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/(self.api_name+'.log')).read_text()[-10000:])
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real kube-apiserver startup timed out')

    def restart_api(self, encryption):
        self.api.terminate();self.api.wait(timeout=10)
        self.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        self.start_api()

    def peer(self, encryption):
        peer=object.__new__(Cluster)
        peer.root=self.root
        peer.processes=[]
        peer.port=free_port();peer.etcd_port=self.etcd_port
        peer.url='https://127.0.0.1:'+str(peer.port)
        peer.api_name='apiserver-peer-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
        peer.encryption_path=self.root/(peer.api_name+'.json')
        peer.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        peer.start_api()
        return peer

    def config(self, identity='learner'):
        result={'server':self.url,'ca':str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'cert':str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),'key':str(self.root/(identity+'.key'))}
        target=self.root/(identity+'-client.json');target.write_text(json.dumps(result))
        return str(target)

    def request(self, method, path, data=None, identity='admin', content_type='application/json'):
        context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(self.root/'ca.crt'))
        context.load_cert_chain(str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),str(self.root/(identity+'.key')))
        conn=http.client.HTTPSConnection('127.0.0.1',self.port,context=context,timeout=5)
        body=json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None
        conn.request(method,path,body=body,headers={'Content-Type':content_type})
        response=conn.getresponse();raw=response.read();code=response.status;conn.close()
        try:return code,json.loads(raw)
        except ValueError:return code,raw.decode(errors='replace')

    def create(self, path, obj):
        code,value=self.request('POST',path,obj)
        assert code==201,(code,value)
        return value

    def namespace(self, name):
        return self.create('/api/v1/namespaces',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Namespace','metadata':{'name':name}})

    def etcd_value(self, key):
        conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=5)
        conn.request('POST','/v3/kv/range',json.dumps({'key':base64.b64encode(key.encode()).decode()}),{'Content-Type':'application/json'})
        response=conn.getresponse();result=json.loads(response.read());conn.close()
        assert response.status==200,result
        return base64.b64decode(result['kvs'][0]['value'])

    def close(self):
        for proc in reversed(self.processes):
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.terminate()
                try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait()
        if hasattr(self,'tmp'):self.tmp.cleanup()

    def __enter__(self):return self
    def __exit__(self,*args):self.close()


if __name__=='__main__':
    started=time.monotonic()
    with Cluster() as cluster:
        print(json.dumps({'ready':cluster.request('GET','/readyz'),'version':cluster.request('GET','/version'),'seconds':time.monotonic()-started}),flush=True)

## 环境与初始材料
固定Go模块及真实私有API；仅编辑task.go和design.json，其他材料不改。

## 操作任务
本题是数据库Operator删除安全的只读验收器：固定完整PolicyReconciler在真实Manager/API/MySQL运行，已有备份actor实际mysqldump并原生mysql恢复核对原数据。实现VerifySafety，phase只是待核声明，必须读取当前CR UID/finalizer、实际数据库是否存在、SQL归属/备份/审计、真实备份文件SHA及恢复表。验证Retain责任、等待备份、DROP权限丢失、真实metadata lock/readTimeout未决、新Manager实例接管、外部清理确认后仅释放自己finalizer。超时后SQL可能执行也可能未执行，未决不能冒称Cleaned；错误API finalizer、损坏备份、虚假Deleted审计应拒绝。实际只读SQL账号不能写，验收器不得修改API/SQL。此题重点验证可靠性证据链，088另题重点实现策略门禁；不宣称新OS进程、Pod或真实云作业。

## 产物
task.go
design.json语义映射：{"role": "read-only-native-safety-verifier", "checkpoints": ["AwaitBackup", "Blocked", "Unresolved", "Cleaned", "Retained"], "evidence": "actual-api-sql-native-dump-restore-and-file-hash", "faults": ["native-drop-permission-loss", "metadata-lock-read-timeout", "new-manager-instance-takeover"], "completion": "physical-cleanup-backup-audit-and-only-own-finalizer-release"}

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py。真实controller-runtime循环及API对象状态变化，参考/未完成/错解/合法替代/原生提前退出分别验证。

## 能力边界
真实Go控制器/工作队列及私有Kubernetes1.34.1 API/etcd3.6.4；独立CA和临时资源，自有PID RSS768MiB/90s预算，默认身份/PATH/GOPATH/context不变。不安装业务或Operator镜像，不声称Pod运行、生产SLO或完整模块验收。

"""Private native API fixture: real etcd and kube-apiserver, no kubeconfig changes."""
import base64
import contextlib
import http.client
import json
import os
import pathlib
import secrets
import socket
import ssl
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time


def free_port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


class Cluster:
    def __init__(self, encryption=None):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-s05-operator-b006-api-')
        self.root = pathlib.Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.processes = []
        self.api_name = 'apiserver'
        self.encryption_path = self.root/'encryption.json'
        self.port, self.etcd_port, self.peer_port = free_port(), free_port(), free_port()
        self.url = 'https://127.0.0.1:' + str(self.port)
        self.run('openssl', 'ecparam', '-name', 'prime256v1', '-genkey', '-noout', '-out', str(self.root/'ca.key'))
        self.run('openssl', 'req', '-x509', '-new', '-key', str(self.root/'ca.key'), '-out', str(self.root/'ca.crt'), '-days', '1', '-subj', '/CN=opsforge-pilot-private-ca')
        self.identity('server', 'localhost', extensions='subjectAltName=IP:127.0.0.1\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\n')
        self.identity('admin', 'opsforge-pilot-admin', 'system:masters')
        self.identity('learner', 'opsforge-pilot-user')
        (self.root/'encryption.json').write_text(json.dumps(encryption or {'apiVersion':'apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1','kind':'EncryptionConfiguration','resources':[{'resources':['secrets'],'providers':[{'identity':{}}]}]}))
        self.etcd = self.spawn('etcd', ['etcd', '--name=pilot', '--data-dir='+str(self.root/'data'), '--listen-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--advertise-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--listen-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-advertise-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-cluster=pilot=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--quota-backend-bytes=67108864', '--logger=zap', '--log-level=error'])
        self.wait_etcd()
        self.start_api()

    def run(self, *args):
        return subprocess.run(args, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)

    def identity(self, name, cn, org=None, extensions='extendedKeyUsage=clientAuth\n'):
        key, csr, crt = [self.root/(name+suffix) for suffix in ('.key','.csr','.crt')]
        self.run('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',str(key))
        self.run('openssl','req','-new','-key',str(key),'-out',str(csr),'-subj','/CN='+cn+('/O='+org if org else ''))
        ext=self.root/(name+'.ext');ext.write_text(extensions)
        self.run('openssl','x509','-req','-in',str(csr),'-CA',str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'-CAkey',str(self.root/'ca.key'),'-CAcreateserial','-out',str(crt),'-days','1','-extfile',str(ext))
        return name

    def spawn(self, name, args):
        handle=(self.root/(name+'.log')).open('ab')
        proc=subprocess.Popen(args,env={**os.environ,"GOMAXPROCS":"2","GOMEMLIMIT":"256MiB"},stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=handle,stderr=handle)
        handle.close();self.processes.append(proc)
        return proc

    def wait_etcd(self):
        for _ in range(120):
            try:
                conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=.3)
                conn.request('GET','/health');response=conn.getresponse();response.read();conn.close()
                if response.status==200:return
            except OSError:pass
            if self.etcd.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/'etcd.log').read_text())
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real etcd startup timed out')

    def start_api(self):
        self.api=self.spawn(self.api_name,['kube-apiserver','--bind-address=127.0.0.1','--advertise-address=127.0.0.1','--secure-port='+str(self.port),'--etcd-servers=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port),'--tls-cert-file='+str(self.root/'server.crt'),'--tls-private-key-file='+str(self.root/'server.key'),'--client-ca-file='+str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC','--enable-admission-plugins=NodeRestriction','--disable-admission-plugins=ServiceAccount','--anonymous-auth=false','--service-cluster-ip-range=10.240.0.0/24','--service-account-issuer=https://kubernetes.default.svc','--service-account-signing-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--service-account-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--encryption-provider-config='+str(self.encryption_path),'--watch-cache=false','--profiling=false','--v=0'])
        for _ in range(240):
            try:
                code,_=self.request('GET','/readyz')
                if code==200:return
            except (OSError,ssl.SSLError,http.client.HTTPException):pass
            if self.api.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/(self.api_name+'.log')).read_text()[-10000:])
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real kube-apiserver startup timed out')

    def restart_api(self, encryption):
        self.api.terminate();self.api.wait(timeout=10)
        self.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        self.start_api()

    def peer(self, encryption):
        peer=object.__new__(Cluster)
        peer.root=self.root
        peer.processes=[]
        peer.port=free_port();peer.etcd_port=self.etcd_port
        peer.url='https://127.0.0.1:'+str(peer.port)
        peer.api_name='apiserver-peer-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
        peer.encryption_path=self.root/(peer.api_name+'.json')
        peer.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        peer.start_api()
        return peer

    def config(self, identity='learner'):
        result={'server':self.url,'ca':str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'cert':str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),'key':str(self.root/(identity+'.key'))}
        target=self.root/(identity+'-client.json');target.write_text(json.dumps(result))
        return str(target)

    def request(self, method, path, data=None, identity='admin', content_type='application/json'):
        context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(self.root/'ca.crt'))
        context.load_cert_chain(str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),str(self.root/(identity+'.key')))
        conn=http.client.HTTPSConnection('127.0.0.1',self.port,context=context,timeout=5)
        body=json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None
        conn.request(method,path,body=body,headers={'Content-Type':content_type})
        response=conn.getresponse();raw=response.read();code=response.status;conn.close()
        try:return code,json.loads(raw)
        except ValueError:return code,raw.decode(errors='replace')

    def create(self, path, obj):
        code,value=self.request('POST',path,obj)
        assert code==201,(code,value)
        return value

    def namespace(self, name):
        return self.create('/api/v1/namespaces',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Namespace','metadata':{'name':name}})

    def etcd_value(self, key):
        conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=5)
        conn.request('POST','/v3/kv/range',json.dumps({'key':base64.b64encode(key.encode()).decode()}),{'Content-Type':'application/json'})
        response=conn.getresponse();result=json.loads(response.read());conn.close()
        assert response.status==200,result
        return base64.b64decode(result['kvs'][0]['value'])

    def close(self):
        for proc in reversed(self.processes):
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.terminate()
                try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait()
        if hasattr(self,'tmp'):self.tmp.cleanup()

    def __enter__(self):return self
    def __exit__(self,*args):self.close()


if __name__=='__main__':
    started=time.monotonic()
    with Cluster() as cluster:
        print(json.dumps({'ready':cluster.request('GET','/readyz'),'version':cluster.request('GET','/version'),'seconds':time.monotonic()-started}),flush=True)

## 环境与初始材料
固定Go模块及真实私有API；仅编辑task.go和design.json，其他材料不改。

## 操作任务
实现多租户一次Create作业的公平配额调度。真实Kubernetes Create API作为外部于调度器的请求目标，分别以标准rate.Limiter限制全局和每tenant调用，独立限制全局/tenant在途数量，不能只限制单CR重试。热tenant排队不能阻塞其他已就绪tenant；限速/在途等待公开Deferred原因及等待指标，实际Create错误也计入调用与错误，未知绑定明确Rejected且不发请求。每tenant显式独立私有证书与仅本namespace的Create权限，真实越界403；真实已有对象409不得接管。可信transport只观察/延迟真正RoundTrip，不伪造回复，直接核实际API请求时间、在途、资源UID、等待/错误指标。这里只证明给定客户端预算，不宣称已申请某云供应商配额，也不更改默认身份或生产API限流配置。

## 产物
task.go
design.json语义映射：{"quota": "global-and-per-tenant-standard-token-buckets", "fairness": "eligible-other-tenant-before-hot-backlog-drains", "inflight": "independent-global-and-tenant-bounds", "visibility": "deferred-reason-wait-and-native-error-metrics", "authorization": "independent-cert-create-only-namespace-role", "native_request": "one-configmap-create-per-bound-job"}

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py。真实controller-runtime循环及API对象状态变化，参考/未完成/错解/合法替代/原生提前退出分别验证。

## 能力边界
真实Go控制器/工作队列及私有Kubernetes1.34.1 API/etcd3.6.4；独立CA和临时资源，自有PID RSS768MiB/90s预算，默认身份/PATH/GOPATH/context不变。不安装业务或Operator镜像，不声称Pod运行、生产SLO或完整模块验收。

FIXED={'go.mod': '794de86e82f603624c7eee9ddf413184954552fae5bba113048fdc3188553943', 'go.sum': 'bb543f322090505347c91d07a0080c2b64ec3c8139a8a2762097b4673a6ba055', 'contract.go': '4875f11fbac01d8e22fdca5e2010c34dd49606cc94c35436c138585b68493994'}
REQUIRED_PLAN={'quota': 'global-and-per-tenant-standard-token-buckets', 'fairness': 'eligible-other-tenant-before-hot-backlog-drains', 'inflight': 'independent-global-and-tenant-bounds', 'visibility': 'deferred-reason-wait-and-native-error-metrics', 'authorization': 'independent-cert-create-only-namespace-role', 'native_request': 'one-configmap-create-per-bound-job'}
GO_MOD_ARGS=[]
NEED_API=True
import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,re,signal,subprocess,sys,time
sys.path.insert(0,'checks')
from bounded_api import BoundedCluster
ROOT=pathlib.Path.cwd()
for name,digest in FIXED.items():
 assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,'fixed material modified: '+name
plan=json.loads((ROOT/'design.json').read_text())
for key,value in REQUIRED_PLAN.items():assert plan.get(key)==value,'design contract: '+key
native=pathlib.Path('/tmp/opsforge-s05-operator-batch002-20261029')
if not (native/'gomodcache/k8s.io/client-go@v0.34.1').is_dir():raise RuntimeError('fixed native client-go module cache missing')
env=dict(os.environ,GOMODCACHE=str(native/'gomodcache'),GOCACHE=str(native/'gocache'),GOPROXY='off',GOTOOLCHAIN='local',GOMAXPROCS='2',GOMEMLIMIT='128MiB',CGO_ENABLED='0')
(ROOT/'native-tmp').mkdir(exist_ok=True);env['TMPDIR']=str(ROOT/'native-tmp')
from bounded_api import Budget
# Compile against the fixed real modules before starting native servers. This
# keeps compiler RSS and API RSS from unnecessarily overlapping; neither budget
# is relaxed. No application source is generated or changed during validation.
with Budget() as compile_budget:
 with (ROOT/'go-compile.log').open('wb') as log:
  compile_proc=subprocess.Popen(['go','test','-mod=readonly',*GO_MOD_ARGS,'-ldflags=-s -w','-c','-o',str(ROOT/'native-tests'),'.'],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env=env,start_new_session=True)
  compile_budget.watch(compile_proc,group=True)
  while compile_proc.poll() is None:compile_budget.check();time.sleep(.03)
  compile_budget.check()
 if compile_proc.returncode:raise RuntimeError('native compilation failed: '+(ROOT/'go-compile.log').read_text()[-3000:])
def execute(budget):
 with (ROOT/'go-native.log').open('wb') as log:
  proc=subprocess.Popen(['go','tool','test2json','-t','-p','opsforge.local/operatorbatch006',str(ROOT/'native-tests'),'-test.count=1','-test.timeout=45s','-test.v=test2json'],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env=env,start_new_session=True)
  budget.watch(proc,group=True)
  while proc.poll() is None:
   budget.check();time.sleep(.03)
  budget.check()
 text=(ROOT/'go-native.log').read_text();print(text)
 if proc.returncode and '--- FAIL:' not in text and 'panic: IMPLEMENT_NATIVE_OPERATION' not in text:raise RuntimeError('native build/tool/checker error: '+text[-3000:])
 assert proc.returncode==0,'native semantic tests failed'
 expected={name for p in ROOT.glob('*_test.go') for name in re.findall(r'^func (Test\w+)\(',p.read_text(),re.M)}
 events=[json.loads(line) for line in text.splitlines() if line.startswith('{')]
 passed={e.get('Test') for e in events if e.get('Action')=='pass' and e.get('Test')}
 assert expected and expected<=passed,'native tests did not all complete; early exit is not success'
if NEED_API:
 with BoundedCluster() as cluster:
  cluster.identity('quota-a','opsforge-quota-a');cluster.identity('quota-b','opsforge-quota-b')
  env['OPSF_QUOTA_A_CONFIG']=cluster.config('quota-a');env['OPSF_QUOTA_B_CONFIG']=cluster.config('quota-b')
  env['OPSF_PRIVATE_CONFIG']=cluster.config('admin');env['OPSF_ETCD_PORT']=str(cluster.etcd_port);execute(cluster.budget)
else:
 with Budget() as budget:execute(budget)
print('NATIVE_OPERATOR_B002_COMPLETE')

"""Private native API fixture: real etcd and kube-apiserver, no kubeconfig changes."""
import base64
import contextlib
import http.client
import json
import os
import pathlib
import secrets
import socket
import ssl
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time


def free_port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


class Cluster:
    def __init__(self, encryption=None):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-s05-operator-b006-api-')
        self.root = pathlib.Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.processes = []
        self.api_name = 'apiserver'
        self.encryption_path = self.root/'encryption.json'
        self.port, self.etcd_port, self.peer_port = free_port(), free_port(), free_port()
        self.url = 'https://127.0.0.1:' + str(self.port)
        self.run('openssl', 'ecparam', '-name', 'prime256v1', '-genkey', '-noout', '-out', str(self.root/'ca.key'))
        self.run('openssl', 'req', '-x509', '-new', '-key', str(self.root/'ca.key'), '-out', str(self.root/'ca.crt'), '-days', '1', '-subj', '/CN=opsforge-pilot-private-ca')
        self.identity('server', 'localhost', extensions='subjectAltName=IP:127.0.0.1\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\n')
        self.identity('admin', 'opsforge-pilot-admin', 'system:masters')
        self.identity('learner', 'opsforge-pilot-user')
        (self.root/'encryption.json').write_text(json.dumps(encryption or {'apiVersion':'apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1','kind':'EncryptionConfiguration','resources':[{'resources':['secrets'],'providers':[{'identity':{}}]}]}))
        self.etcd = self.spawn('etcd', ['etcd', '--name=pilot', '--data-dir='+str(self.root/'data'), '--listen-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--advertise-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--listen-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-advertise-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-cluster=pilot=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--quota-backend-bytes=67108864', '--logger=zap', '--log-level=error'])
        self.wait_etcd()
        self.start_api()

    def run(self, *args):
        return subprocess.run(args, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)

    def identity(self, name, cn, org=None, extensions='extendedKeyUsage=clientAuth\n'):
        key, csr, crt = [self.root/(name+suffix) for suffix in ('.key','.csr','.crt')]
        self.run('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',str(key))
        self.run('openssl','req','-new','-key',str(key),'-out',str(csr),'-subj','/CN='+cn+('/O='+org if org else ''))
        ext=self.root/(name+'.ext');ext.write_text(extensions)
        self.run('openssl','x509','-req','-in',str(csr),'-CA',str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'-CAkey',str(self.root/'ca.key'),'-CAcreateserial','-out',str(crt),'-days','1','-extfile',str(ext))
        return name

    def spawn(self, name, args):
        handle=(self.root/(name+'.log')).open('ab')
        proc=subprocess.Popen(args,env={**os.environ,"GOMAXPROCS":"2","GOMEMLIMIT":"256MiB"},stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=handle,stderr=handle)
        handle.close();self.processes.append(proc)
        return proc

    def wait_etcd(self):
        for _ in range(120):
            try:
                conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=.3)
                conn.request('GET','/health');response=conn.getresponse();response.read();conn.close()
                if response.status==200:return
            except OSError:pass
            if self.etcd.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/'etcd.log').read_text())
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real etcd startup timed out')

    def start_api(self):
        self.api=self.spawn(self.api_name,['kube-apiserver','--bind-address=127.0.0.1','--advertise-address=127.0.0.1','--secure-port='+str(self.port),'--etcd-servers=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port),'--tls-cert-file='+str(self.root/'server.crt'),'--tls-private-key-file='+str(self.root/'server.key'),'--client-ca-file='+str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC','--enable-admission-plugins=NodeRestriction','--disable-admission-plugins=ServiceAccount','--anonymous-auth=false','--service-cluster-ip-range=10.240.0.0/24','--service-account-issuer=https://kubernetes.default.svc','--service-account-signing-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--service-account-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--encryption-provider-config='+str(self.encryption_path),'--watch-cache=false','--profiling=false','--v=0'])
        for _ in range(240):
            try:
                code,_=self.request('GET','/readyz')
                if code==200:return
            except (OSError,ssl.SSLError,http.client.HTTPException):pass
            if self.api.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/(self.api_name+'.log')).read_text()[-10000:])
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real kube-apiserver startup timed out')

    def restart_api(self, encryption):
        self.api.terminate();self.api.wait(timeout=10)
        self.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        self.start_api()

    def peer(self, encryption):
        peer=object.__new__(Cluster)
        peer.root=self.root
        peer.processes=[]
        peer.port=free_port();peer.etcd_port=self.etcd_port
        peer.url='https://127.0.0.1:'+str(peer.port)
        peer.api_name='apiserver-peer-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
        peer.encryption_path=self.root/(peer.api_name+'.json')
        peer.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        peer.start_api()
        return peer

    def config(self, identity='learner'):
        result={'server':self.url,'ca':str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'cert':str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),'key':str(self.root/(identity+'.key'))}
        target=self.root/(identity+'-client.json');target.write_text(json.dumps(result))
        return str(target)

    def request(self, method, path, data=None, identity='admin', content_type='application/json'):
        context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(self.root/'ca.crt'))
        context.load_cert_chain(str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),str(self.root/(identity+'.key')))
        conn=http.client.HTTPSConnection('127.0.0.1',self.port,context=context,timeout=5)
        body=json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None
        conn.request(method,path,body=body,headers={'Content-Type':content_type})
        response=conn.getresponse();raw=response.read();code=response.status;conn.close()
        try:return code,json.loads(raw)
        except ValueError:return code,raw.decode(errors='replace')

    def create(self, path, obj):
        code,value=self.request('POST',path,obj)
        assert code==201,(code,value)
        return value

    def namespace(self, name):
        return self.create('/api/v1/namespaces',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Namespace','metadata':{'name':name}})

    def etcd_value(self, key):
        conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=5)
        conn.request('POST','/v3/kv/range',json.dumps({'key':base64.b64encode(key.encode()).decode()}),{'Content-Type':'application/json'})
        response=conn.getresponse();result=json.loads(response.read());conn.close()
        assert response.status==200,result
        return base64.b64decode(result['kvs'][0]['value'])

    def close(self):
        for proc in reversed(self.processes):
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.terminate()
                try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait()
        if hasattr(self,'tmp'):self.tmp.cleanup()

    def __enter__(self):return self
    def __exit__(self,*args):self.close()


if __name__=='__main__':
    started=time.monotonic()
    with Cluster() as cluster:
        print(json.dumps({'ready':cluster.request('GET','/readyz'),'version':cluster.request('GET','/version'),'seconds':time.monotonic()-started}),flush=True)

body:
## 环境与初始材料
固定Go模块及真实私有API；仅编辑task.go和design.json，其他材料不改。

## 操作任务
实现Identity和Apply。实际client-go队列/缓存键包含cluster、namespace、name、UID；用显式绑定且仅授权same命名空间的真实客户端读写Unit CR.status。核对UID，状态patch携带resourceVersion乐观锁，保留spec及其他状态；仅已提交写形成Trace和缓存，operationKey持久化到真实status。测试两个独立CA/API的同名CR及同名重建、错集群证书、跨命名空间403和未知cluster。外部幂等键只证明命名域，不声称创建云资源。本题聚焦显式路由/完整身份，097另验并发/故障域。

## 产物
task.go
design.json语义映射：{"queue-cache": "cluster-namespace-name-uid", "client": "explicit-cluster-minimal-role", "write": "uid-rv-fenced-status", "audit": "committed-target-identity", "external-key": "cluster-qualified-status-record-not-cloud"}

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py。真实controller-runtime循环及API对象状态变化，参考/未完成/错解/合法替代/原生提前退出分别验证。

## 能力边界
真实Go控制器/工作队列及私有Kubernetes1.34.1 API/etcd3.6.4；独立CA和临时资源，自有PID RSS768MiB/90s预算，默认身份/PATH/GOPATH/context不变。不安装业务或Operator镜像，不声称Pod运行、生产SLO或完整模块验收。

"""Private native API fixture: real etcd and kube-apiserver, no kubeconfig changes."""
import base64
import contextlib
import http.client
import json
import os
import pathlib
import secrets
import socket
import ssl
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time


def free_port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


class Cluster:
    def __init__(self, encryption=None):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-s05-operator-b006-cross-api-',dir=pathlib.Path.cwd())
        self.root = pathlib.Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.processes = []
        self.api_name = 'apiserver'
        self.encryption_path = self.root/'encryption.json'
        self.port, self.etcd_port, self.peer_port = free_port(), free_port(), free_port()
        self.url = 'https://127.0.0.1:' + str(self.port)
        self.run('openssl', 'ecparam', '-name', 'prime256v1', '-genkey', '-noout', '-out', str(self.root/'ca.key'))
        self.run('openssl', 'req', '-x509', '-new', '-key', str(self.root/'ca.key'), '-out', str(self.root/'ca.crt'), '-days', '1', '-subj', '/CN=opsforge-pilot-private-ca')
        self.identity('server', 'localhost', extensions='subjectAltName=IP:127.0.0.1\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\n')
        self.identity('admin', 'opsforge-pilot-admin', 'system:masters')
        self.identity('learner', 'opsforge-pilot-user')
        (self.root/'encryption.json').write_text(json.dumps(encryption or {'apiVersion':'apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1','kind':'EncryptionConfiguration','resources':[{'resources':['secrets'],'providers':[{'identity':{}}]}]}))
        self.etcd = self.spawn('etcd', ['etcd', '--name=pilot', '--data-dir='+str(self.root/'data'), '--listen-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--advertise-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--listen-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-advertise-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-cluster=pilot=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--quota-backend-bytes=67108864', '--logger=zap', '--log-level=error'])
        self.wait_etcd()
        self.start_api()

    def run(self, *args):
        return subprocess.run(args, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)

    def identity(self, name, cn, org=None, extensions='extendedKeyUsage=clientAuth\n'):
        key, csr, crt = [self.root/(name+suffix) for suffix in ('.key','.csr','.crt')]
        self.run('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',str(key))
        self.run('openssl','req','-new','-key',str(key),'-out',str(csr),'-subj','/CN='+cn+('/O='+org if org else ''))
        ext=self.root/(name+'.ext');ext.write_text(extensions)
        self.run('openssl','x509','-req','-in',str(csr),'-CA',str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'-CAkey',str(self.root/'ca.key'),'-CAcreateserial','-out',str(crt),'-days','1','-extfile',str(ext))
        return name

    def spawn(self, name, args):
        handle=(self.root/(name+'.log')).open('ab')
        proc=subprocess.Popen(args,env={**os.environ,"GOMAXPROCS":"2","GOMEMLIMIT":"256MiB"},stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=handle,stderr=handle)
        handle.close();self.processes.append(proc)
        stat=pathlib.Path("/proc",str(proc.pid),"stat").read_text();tail=stat[stat.rfind(")")+2:].split()
        print("OPSF_OWNED_PID "+json.dumps({"pid":proc.pid,"start_ticks":tail[19],"root":str(self.root)}),flush=True)
        return proc

    def wait_etcd(self):
        for _ in range(120):
            try:
                conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=.3)
                conn.request('GET','/health');response=conn.getresponse();response.read();conn.close()
                if response.status==200:return
            except OSError:pass
            if self.etcd.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/'etcd.log').read_text())
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real etcd startup timed out')

    def start_api(self):
        self.api=self.spawn(self.api_name,['kube-apiserver','--bind-address=127.0.0.1','--advertise-address=127.0.0.1','--secure-port='+str(self.port),'--etcd-servers=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port),'--tls-cert-file='+str(self.root/'server.crt'),'--tls-private-key-file='+str(self.root/'server.key'),'--client-ca-file='+str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC','--enable-admission-plugins=NodeRestriction','--disable-admission-plugins=ServiceAccount','--anonymous-auth=false','--service-cluster-ip-range=10.240.0.0/24','--service-account-issuer=https://kubernetes.default.svc','--service-account-signing-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--service-account-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--encryption-provider-config='+str(self.encryption_path),'--watch-cache=false','--profiling=false','--v=0'])
        for _ in range(240):
            try:
                code,_=self.request('GET','/readyz')
                if code==200:return
            except (OSError,ssl.SSLError,http.client.HTTPException):pass
            if self.api.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/(self.api_name+'.log')).read_text()[-10000:])
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real kube-apiserver startup timed out')

    def restart_api(self, encryption):
        self.api.terminate();self.api.wait(timeout=10)
        self.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        self.start_api()

    def peer(self, encryption):
        peer=object.__new__(Cluster)
        peer.root=self.root
        peer.processes=[]
        peer.port=free_port();peer.etcd_port=self.etcd_port
        peer.url='https://127.0.0.1:'+str(peer.port)
        peer.api_name='apiserver-peer-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
        peer.encryption_path=self.root/(peer.api_name+'.json')
        peer.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        peer.start_api()
        return peer

    def config(self, identity='learner'):
        result={'server':self.url,'ca':str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'cert':str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),'key':str(self.root/(identity+'.key'))}
        target=self.root/(identity+'-client.json');target.write_text(json.dumps(result))
        return str(target)

    def request(self, method, path, data=None, identity='admin', content_type='application/json'):
        context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(self.root/'ca.crt'))
        context.load_cert_chain(str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),str(self.root/(identity+'.key')))
        conn=http.client.HTTPSConnection('127.0.0.1',self.port,context=context,timeout=5)
        body=json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None
        conn.request(method,path,body=body,headers={'Content-Type':content_type})
        response=conn.getresponse();raw=response.read();code=response.status;conn.close()
        try:return code,json.loads(raw)
        except ValueError:return code,raw.decode(errors='replace')

    def create(self, path, obj):
        code,value=self.request('POST',path,obj)
        assert code==201,(code,value)
        return value

    def namespace(self, name):
        return self.create('/api/v1/namespaces',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Namespace','metadata':{'name':name}})

    def etcd_value(self, key):
        conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=5)
        conn.request('POST','/v3/kv/range',json.dumps({'key':base64.b64encode(key.encode()).decode()}),{'Content-Type':'application/json'})
        response=conn.getresponse();result=json.loads(response.read());conn.close()
        assert response.status==200,result
        return base64.b64decode(result['kvs'][0]['value'])

    def close(self):
        for proc in reversed(self.processes):
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.terminate()
                try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait()
        if hasattr(self,'tmp'):self.tmp.cleanup()

    def __enter__(self):return self
    def __exit__(self,*args):self.close()


if __name__=='__main__':
    started=time.monotonic()
    with Cluster() as cluster:
        print(json.dumps({'ready':cluster.request('GET','/readyz'),'version':cluster.request('GET','/version'),'seconds':time.monotonic()-started}),flush=True)

## 环境与初始材料
固定Go模块及真实私有API；仅编辑task.go和design.json，其他材料不改。

## 操作任务
实现Run：显式绑定两个独立CA/API的最小命名空间权限客户端，完整cluster/namespace/name/UID任务身份；全局与每集群独立并发上限；真实读取/UID核对/带RV状态patch，operationKey实际持久化CR.status，各集群缓存和成功/失败日志保留完整目标。原生HTTP transport仅计数并延迟实际RoundTrip，不伪造响应；暂停alpha真实API进程，使请求真实超时，beta必须在alpha恢复前提交。恢复alpha后接管未决工作，beta不改。只证明外部幂等键命名域及实际status记录，不冒充真实云创建；092另验队列路由。本题无运行Pod或生产部署。

## 产物
task.go
design.json语义映射：{"identity": "cluster-namespace-name-uid", "credentials": "independent-ca-namespace-role", "concurrency": "global-and-per-cluster-inflight", "failure-domain": "alpha-real-api-paused-beta-commits", "external-key": "cluster-qualified-real-status-not-cloud", "cache-audit": "qualified-by-cluster"}

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py。真实controller-runtime循环及API对象状态变化，参考/未完成/错解/合法替代/原生提前退出分别验证。

## 能力边界
真实Go控制器/工作队列及私有Kubernetes1.34.1 API/etcd3.6.4；独立CA和临时资源，自有PID RSS768MiB/90s预算，默认身份/PATH/GOPATH/context不变。不安装业务或Operator镜像，不声称Pod运行、生产SLO或完整模块验收。

FIXED={'go.mod': '794de86e82f603624c7eee9ddf413184954552fae5bba113048fdc3188553943', 'go.sum': 'bb543f322090505347c91d07a0080c2b64ec3c8139a8a2762097b4673a6ba055', 'contract.go': '6074931a9041e1bef72c33fa15a64c23ff378188ef9c08eaa05b58f4e9dd7b18', 'unit-crd.json': '6d99084529809fbb919e8b2bf4af9b3b2f912d8e6b36604907bdb8ac10106d1a'}
REQUIRED_PLAN={'identity': 'cluster-namespace-name-uid', 'credentials': 'independent-ca-namespace-role', 'concurrency': 'global-and-per-cluster-inflight', 'failure-domain': 'alpha-real-api-paused-beta-commits', 'external-key': 'cluster-qualified-real-status-not-cloud', 'cache-audit': 'qualified-by-cluster'}
GO_MOD_ARGS=[]
NEED_API=True
import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,re,signal,subprocess,sys,time
sys.path.insert(0,'checks')
from bounded_api import BoundedCluster
ROOT=pathlib.Path.cwd()
for name,digest in FIXED.items():
 assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,'fixed material modified: '+name
plan=json.loads((ROOT/'design.json').read_text())
for key,value in REQUIRED_PLAN.items():assert plan.get(key)==value,'design contract: '+key
native=pathlib.Path('/tmp/opsforge-s05-operator-batch002-20261029')
if not (native/'gomodcache/k8s.io/client-go@v0.34.1').is_dir():raise RuntimeError('fixed native client-go module cache missing')
env=dict(os.environ,GOMODCACHE=str(native/'gomodcache'),GOCACHE=str(native/'gocache'),GOPROXY='off',GOTOOLCHAIN='local',GOMAXPROCS='2',GOMEMLIMIT='128MiB',CGO_ENABLED='0')
(ROOT/'native-tmp').mkdir(exist_ok=True);env['TMPDIR']=str(ROOT/'native-tmp')
from bounded_api import Budget
# Compile against the fixed real modules before starting native servers. This
# keeps compiler RSS and API RSS from unnecessarily overlapping; neither budget
# is relaxed. No application source is generated or changed during validation.
with Budget() as compile_budget:
 with (ROOT/'go-compile.log').open('wb') as log:
  compile_proc=subprocess.Popen(['go','test','-mod=readonly',*GO_MOD_ARGS,'-ldflags=-s -w','-c','-o',str(ROOT/'native-tests'),'.'],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env=env,start_new_session=True)
  compile_budget.watch(compile_proc,group=True)
  while compile_proc.poll() is None:compile_budget.check();time.sleep(.03)
  compile_budget.check()
 if compile_proc.returncode:raise RuntimeError('native compilation failed: '+(ROOT/'go-compile.log').read_text()[-3000:])
def execute(budget):
 with (ROOT/'go-native.log').open('wb') as log:
  proc=subprocess.Popen(['go','tool','test2json','-t','-p','opsforge.local/operatorbatch006',str(ROOT/'native-tests'),'-test.count=1','-test.timeout=45s','-test.v=test2json'],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env=env,start_new_session=True)
  budget.watch(proc,group=True)
  while proc.poll() is None:
   budget.check();time.sleep(.03)
  budget.check()
 text=(ROOT/'go-native.log').read_text();print(text)
 if proc.returncode and '--- FAIL:' not in text and 'panic: IMPLEMENT_NATIVE_OPERATION' not in text:raise RuntimeError('native build/tool/checker error: '+text[-3000:])
 assert proc.returncode==0,'native semantic tests failed'
 expected={name for p in ROOT.glob('*_test.go') for name in re.findall(r'^func (Test\w+)\(',p.read_text(),re.M)}
 events=[json.loads(line) for line in text.splitlines() if line.startswith('{')]
 passed={e.get('Test') for e in events if e.get('Action')=='pass' and e.get('Test')}
 assert expected and expected<=passed,'native tests did not all complete; early exit is not success'
if NEED_API:
 from private_api import Cluster
 class Twin(Cluster):
  def __init__(self,budget):self.budget=budget;super().__init__()
  def spawn(self,name,args):p=super().spawn(name,args);self.budget.watch(p);return p
 with Budget() as budget:
  with Twin(budget) as a,Twin(budget) as b:
   for cluster,key in [(a,'OPSF_PRIVATE_CONFIG'),(b,'OPSF_PRIVATE_CONFIG_B')]:
    path=pathlib.Path(cluster.config('admin'));config=json.loads(path.read_text());config.update(learner_cert=str(cluster.root/'learner.crt'),learner_key=str(cluster.root/'learner.key'));path.write_text(json.dumps(config));env[key]=str(path)
   env['OPSF_ALPHA_API_PID']=str(a.api.pid)
   execute(budget)
else:
 with Budget() as budget:execute(budget)
print('NATIVE_OPERATOR_B002_COMPLETE')

"""Private native API fixture: real etcd and kube-apiserver, no kubeconfig changes."""
import base64
import contextlib
import http.client
import json
import os
import pathlib
import secrets
import socket
import ssl
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time


def free_port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


class Cluster:
    def __init__(self, encryption=None):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-s05-operator-b006-cross-api-',dir=pathlib.Path.cwd())
        self.root = pathlib.Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.processes = []
        self.api_name = 'apiserver'
        self.encryption_path = self.root/'encryption.json'
        self.port, self.etcd_port, self.peer_port = free_port(), free_port(), free_port()
        self.url = 'https://127.0.0.1:' + str(self.port)
        self.run('openssl', 'ecparam', '-name', 'prime256v1', '-genkey', '-noout', '-out', str(self.root/'ca.key'))
        self.run('openssl', 'req', '-x509', '-new', '-key', str(self.root/'ca.key'), '-out', str(self.root/'ca.crt'), '-days', '1', '-subj', '/CN=opsforge-pilot-private-ca')
        self.identity('server', 'localhost', extensions='subjectAltName=IP:127.0.0.1\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\n')
        self.identity('admin', 'opsforge-pilot-admin', 'system:masters')
        self.identity('learner', 'opsforge-pilot-user')
        (self.root/'encryption.json').write_text(json.dumps(encryption or {'apiVersion':'apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1','kind':'EncryptionConfiguration','resources':[{'resources':['secrets'],'providers':[{'identity':{}}]}]}))
        self.etcd = self.spawn('etcd', ['etcd', '--name=pilot', '--data-dir='+str(self.root/'data'), '--listen-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--advertise-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--listen-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-advertise-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-cluster=pilot=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--quota-backend-bytes=67108864', '--logger=zap', '--log-level=error'])
        self.wait_etcd()
        self.start_api()

    def run(self, *args):
        return subprocess.run(args, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)

    def identity(self, name, cn, org=None, extensions='extendedKeyUsage=clientAuth\n'):
        key, csr, crt = [self.root/(name+suffix) for suffix in ('.key','.csr','.crt')]
        self.run('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',str(key))
        self.run('openssl','req','-new','-key',str(key),'-out',str(csr),'-subj','/CN='+cn+('/O='+org if org else ''))
        ext=self.root/(name+'.ext');ext.write_text(extensions)
        self.run('openssl','x509','-req','-in',str(csr),'-CA',str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'-CAkey',str(self.root/'ca.key'),'-CAcreateserial','-out',str(crt),'-days','1','-extfile',str(ext))
        return name

    def spawn(self, name, args):
        handle=(self.root/(name+'.log')).open('ab')
        proc=subprocess.Popen(args,env={**os.environ,"GOMAXPROCS":"2","GOMEMLIMIT":"256MiB"},stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=handle,stderr=handle)
        handle.close();self.processes.append(proc)
        stat=pathlib.Path("/proc",str(proc.pid),"stat").read_text();tail=stat[stat.rfind(")")+2:].split()
        print("OPSF_OWNED_PID "+json.dumps({"pid":proc.pid,"start_ticks":tail[19],"root":str(self.root)}),flush=True)
        return proc

    def wait_etcd(self):
        for _ in range(120):
            try:
                conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=.3)
                conn.request('GET','/health');response=conn.getresponse();response.read();conn.close()
                if response.status==200:return
            except OSError:pass
            if self.etcd.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/'etcd.log').read_text())
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real etcd startup timed out')

    def start_api(self):
        self.api=self.spawn(self.api_name,['kube-apiserver','--bind-address=127.0.0.1','--advertise-address=127.0.0.1','--secure-port='+str(self.port),'--etcd-servers=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port),'--tls-cert-file='+str(self.root/'server.crt'),'--tls-private-key-file='+str(self.root/'server.key'),'--client-ca-file='+str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC','--enable-admission-plugins=NodeRestriction','--disable-admission-plugins=ServiceAccount','--anonymous-auth=false','--service-cluster-ip-range=10.240.0.0/24','--service-account-issuer=https://kubernetes.default.svc','--service-account-signing-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--service-account-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--encryption-provider-config='+str(self.encryption_path),'--watch-cache=false','--profiling=false','--v=0'])
        for _ in range(240):
            try:
                code,_=self.request('GET','/readyz')
                if code==200:return
            except (OSError,ssl.SSLError,http.client.HTTPException):pass
            if self.api.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/(self.api_name+'.log')).read_text()[-10000:])
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real kube-apiserver startup timed out')

    def restart_api(self, encryption):
        self.api.terminate();self.api.wait(timeout=10)
        self.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        self.start_api()

    def peer(self, encryption):
        peer=object.__new__(Cluster)
        peer.root=self.root
        peer.processes=[]
        peer.port=free_port();peer.etcd_port=self.etcd_port
        peer.url='https://127.0.0.1:'+str(peer.port)
        peer.api_name='apiserver-peer-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
        peer.encryption_path=self.root/(peer.api_name+'.json')
        peer.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        peer.start_api()
        return peer

    def config(self, identity='learner'):
        result={'server':self.url,'ca':str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'cert':str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),'key':str(self.root/(identity+'.key'))}
        target=self.root/(identity+'-client.json');target.write_text(json.dumps(result))
        return str(target)

    def request(self, method, path, data=None, identity='admin', content_type='application/json'):
        context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(self.root/'ca.crt'))
        context.load_cert_chain(str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),str(self.root/(identity+'.key')))
        conn=http.client.HTTPSConnection('127.0.0.1',self.port,context=context,timeout=5)
        body=json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None
        conn.request(method,path,body=body,headers={'Content-Type':content_type})
        response=conn.getresponse();raw=response.read();code=response.status;conn.close()
        try:return code,json.loads(raw)
        except ValueError:return code,raw.decode(errors='replace')

    def create(self, path, obj):
        code,value=self.request('POST',path,obj)
        assert code==201,(code,value)
        return value

    def namespace(self, name):
        return self.create('/api/v1/namespaces',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Namespace','metadata':{'name':name}})

    def etcd_value(self, key):
        conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=5)
        conn.request('POST','/v3/kv/range',json.dumps({'key':base64.b64encode(key.encode()).decode()}),{'Content-Type':'application/json'})
        response=conn.getresponse();result=json.loads(response.read());conn.close()
        assert response.status==200,result
        return base64.b64decode(result['kvs'][0]['value'])

    def close(self):
        for proc in reversed(self.processes):
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.terminate()
                try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait()
        if hasattr(self,'tmp'):self.tmp.cleanup()

    def __enter__(self):return self
    def __exit__(self,*args):self.close()


if __name__=='__main__':
    started=time.monotonic()
    with Cluster() as cluster:
        print(json.dumps({'ready':cluster.request('GET','/readyz'),'version':cluster.request('GET','/version'),'seconds':time.monotonic()-started}),flush=True)
